description:
Suitable for long term rentals. Business travel, erasmus..
An apartment with 5-star hotel amenities. Designed to make families feel at home. Many places such as restaurants & markets open 24/7, pharmacies, cafes, bars are within 1-2 min walking distance. It is within walking distance to places such as Nişantaşı, Bomonti. Cevahir AVM. It is 8-10 minutes walking distance from metro station. In this way, you can go to places such as Taksim, Galata Tower, Galata Bridge, Hagia Sophia and Sultanahmet.

reviews.text:
We stayed at Tuğkan Berke’s place for 9 nights and had a great time! The place is nice and clean and looks exactly like the photos. One thing that stands out is that the building has an elevator. As basic as it is, it was hard to find a descent place with elevator in Istanbul. Many places didn’t have a lift and even if they did, it didn’t work for the basement level where many of these places are located. Given that, Tuğkan’s was a rare find in my opinion.
Host was very friendly and responsive. He sent me a list of recommendations for places to visit and restaurants which was extremely helpful! He even reached out to me a couple of times during our stay to make sure everything was fine and if we needed anything, which I truly appreciate! Check-in and check-out was also easy.
Neighborhood is safe and quite and in a nice area. It is a little steep (like almost everywhere in Istanbul) but we had no problems as we could always get a taxi easily!
I highly recommend this place!

my stay at Mr Berke’s place. When I first saw his reviews I was impressed. When I first arrived with my guest James which was delayed due to a difficult time finding it with our taxi driver.when we finally arrived to both our disappointment the unit was in the basement.The strong smell and the actual roach pellets were in the sink in the kitchen and the bathroom ! My guest has Asthma and was feeling ill . Within min we saw three roaches in the kitchen and one by the front door. We immediately looked at the condition of the place . We found the pillows and bedding were not as he claims . The bed is hard , the pillows cheap, the sheets like sandpaper . We felt that this place falsely advertised the claims and reviews . I immediately contacted Air BnB they started an investigation. The claim that it is 7 min from the metro isn’t true it’s 18 min and not an easy walk uphill . A few day in Air BnB contacted me to say

The place is just as perfect as in Photos. Tugkan is a perfect host, he responds fast, helps you with everything, and is always there for you. The location is perfect, close to the metro, stores, and coffee shops. I would recommend it for a short or long-term stay.

I recently stayed at Tuğkan and was pleased to find that the house exactly matched the photos. The host was attentive and responsive, efficiently addressing any requests I had. The place had a comfortable, home-like feel, making my stay both enjoyable and relaxing.
Highly recommend for a peaceful and reliable stay.

description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.
The flat is in the center of Moda in Kadikoy with quick access to public transportation. Entertainment and shopping locations, with a wide range of restaurants that are within a walking distance.

The flat is on the ground floor.

The flat is fully equipped with all the utensils and tools necessary including: high-speed internet (100Mbps), dishwasher, washing machine, fridge, Smart TV, vacuum cleaner, iron, coffee machine, etc.

reviews.text: We had a very comfortable stay at Elvan’s place as a family of 4 with small kids. The apartment was very easy to find with very clear instructions on how to enter. Location was excellent, in walking distance to the metro, ferry, shops and restaurants, yet located on a super quiet street with no street noise. There is also a small local market across the street to buy amenities if needed (snacks, toiletries etc.) The apartment itself was very clean and the beds were comfortable. There was lots of space for large suitcases in the main bedroom. The kitchen was also well equipped (utensils, plates, cups, coffee machine, toaster etc.) though we didn’t cook any meals as there were so many easy food options nearby. We overall felt at home and Elvan was very friendly, helpful and response, the perfect host! We would definitely stay here again, 5 stars.

I highly recommend staying here! It is a fantastic place and a great location.
The apartment was exactly as pictured, clean upon arrival, and had a welcoming 'home' feeling. All appliances worked perfectly. It offers the best of both worlds: it is close to cafes, bars, restaurants, and supermarkets just three streets away, and the seaside is only a few blocks down. Despite being near the action, the street was incredibly quiet for a great night's sleep.Both the vapur (ferry) and metro are within walking distance, making it seamless to travel to the Old Town by ferry and explore via tram. If you arrive by car, there are three İSPARK locations very close by with very reasonable prices. Choosing this area over Etiler saved us a lot of time, as we avoided the heavy bus traffic.The was very nice, super kind, highly responsive, and helpful throughout our stay.

Great place in a great location.
European side is easily accessible from Kadikoy metro or ferry port - 15 mins walk. You’re a couple of minutes walk from a lot of coffee shops and convenience stores - and 10 minutes walk from the bars, restaurants and shops of Kadikoy (far better value than the European side).
Apartment is spacious and clean, on a quiet street.
Elvan was a great host and gave clear instructions and proactive help before and during our stay.

Elvan is a terrific host, welcoming and very supportive. She is easy to communicate with and her advice proved to be invaluable, when one of our friends got sick
and Elvan pointed out the only pharmacy on duty in the area with all others being closed due to Ramadan holiday.
The apartment itself is spacious, clean and comfortable with all amenities one may require for their stay. A few minutes walk in any direction and you can reach numerous cafes and restaurants. The pier and waterfront is also nearby, making it an easy trip to the other side of the city.
Staying at the apartment was a joyful experience, which I would gladly recommend.

Elvan was the perfect host from booking through to departure. Before we even arrived she went out of her way to make sure everything was perfect for our stay. This is the first time we had travelled abroad with our 7 month old baby and so we were very anxious. However Elvan ensured our stay was as comfortable as possible and our baby had everything he needed. The location was perfect to get to all the restaurants and sights in moda and nearby. The beds were comfortable and the apartment very clean. We would definitely stay here again. Thank you so much 😊

description: Take it easy at this unique and tranquil getaway.

reviews.text: Beautiful place with a stunning view. The apartment is clean and comfortable, and the host is communicative and respectful. I enjoyed my stay here, however, I would recommend changing the bathroom door and lighting. The location is nice and close to public transportation, but you will need to climb steep stairs to reach the apartment building. Not recommended for elder persons.

Yüksel Bey’s apartment was accurately described with an amazing view and is nicely centrally located. He also very kindly helped me out when I had a small emergency, I'm very grateful to him. The young man who checked me was also very nice and helpful as well. I definitely recommend this Airbnb as long as you are reasonably fit and don't mind climbing some stairs!

Everything was good at Yüksel's place. It was close to everything (tram and good restaurants and Taksim), looked like in the photos and the host is responsive. The only downside was that we had big luggages and it is located in the middle of a hill with many stairs. But overall is good!

The hosts are very kind and helpful.
The place is clean and there’s a laundry and clean towels whenever you want.
The location of the place is amazing, literally it’s near of the most common areas in Istanbul like taksim, galtabort, metro and ships for transportation to other areas.
overall, it’s great place for vacation in istanbul.
Thanks for Mr. Mohmet and the other hosts for this great experience.

reviews.text:
The location is great, its prime location, in the middle of Kadikoy. So many restaurants around, and it's 10 mins away to the ferry, and 15 mins walking distance to the closest metro/train station.
The bed didn't have a sheet on it that covers it fully, so I was able to see stains on the bed. The shower was super small, it would be better if they extend the size of the shower.
Overall, the landlord was always responsive and helpful, the airbnb was good for the price/location, however, just needs some improvements in term of hygiene and shower size.

I had a wonderful stay at this apartment! The place was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. The location was perfect — close to everything I needed, yet quiet and peaceful at night. The host was very friendly, responsive, and made sure I had everything I needed for a comfortable stay. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting the area and would love to come back

We really enjoyed our stay here! The location in Kadiköy is perfect - it's in a neighborhood with so many nearby restaurants and dessert shops and situated on a cute, picturesque alley with an amazing coffeeshop on the corner. Our host provided us with clear instructions for check-in and was very responsive. The airbnb was clean and it was nice to have the air conditioning unit to cool off after being out and about during the day.

Volkan was very helpful and quick to respond. The apartment was very clean and quiet even though it’s right above a busy bar street.
Place is central and safe to walk at night and the neighbourhood is vibrant and friendly.
Definitely value for money if you’re looking for a lower budget stay. Next time I’m in Istanbul I’ll strongly consider this apartment and host again.
Keep in mind the building has no elevator, so people with accessibility needs or heavy bags should take it into consideration.

reviews.text:
On Airbnb website we got the impression of a shared apartment with a homey feel and a welcoming host. Was not the case. We were not welcomed by anyone. Almost never anyone in the reception. It was more like a cheap hostel.
With no “checking in” and showing identification we were a bit worried about the security of the place. All it took to enter the common area was a code.
The room was fine for the price, however not cleaned properly. The air condition was extremely dirty so we didn’t use it.
The common kitchen was very messy and not made for a hostel of this capacity.
Gayet temiz, güzeldi. Konumu da aynı şekilde. Biz memnun kaldık.

İlk girdiğimde temiz gibi gözükse de mutfak eşyaları yağlıydı, çarşafın altında da kondom çıktı maalesef. Ayrıca yatağın sok kısmına ağırlık yaptıkça çöküyordu. Banyodan da pis kokular geliyordu, gider problemi var. El sabunu, şampuan gibi deterjan malzemeleri yoktu sonradan istediğimizde sadece el sabunu getirdiler. Yalnızca konumunu ve ortamın samimi havasını sevdim, herkes kendi halinde ve mutlu.

Geçirdiğimiz dört günlük kısa süreli tatilimiz içinde bu konaklama yeri hem konumu hem temizliği açısından gerçekten çok iyiydi. Hiçbir sorunla karşılaşmadık, bir sonraki tatilimizde de yine burayı tercih ederiz ❤️‍🔥😇
Good location, budget-friendly

description:
We offer our guests a comfortable stay in our apartment, which is located 5 minutes from Sabiha Gökçen Airport. Our apartment is equipped to meet all your needs and has been designed to make you, our valued guests, feel right at home. Cleanliness and hygiene are among the top issues we are sensitive about.
In terms of location, it is 5 minutes away from SAW Airport, 3 minutes away from Teknopak, 5 minutes away from Viaport Shopping Mall, and 15 minutes away from the Formula 1 racetrack. It is approximately 15 minutes away from Okan University and Sabancı University.

reviews.text:
We stayed for just one night as we needed a place to rest between flights. We wished we could stay longer!
The apartment was just 10 minutes away from the airport and we were able to get a private care provided by our host for a very small fee.
The apartment was spotlessly clean, modern and beautiful. The shower was wonderful, the bed and couch bed were very comfortable too.
The building the apartment is located in is very safe and secure with a manned security desk.
The surrounding area has everything one would need, shops, cafés and restaurants right outside in a very modern and beautiful neighbourhood.
Our host was extremely friendly, informative and very attentive to any of our needs or requests.
When we return to Istanbul for a longer stay we will be choosing here to stay❤️

2 gecelik konaklamamız boyunca her şey gerçekten harikaydı. Ev hem çok temiz hem de fotoğraflarda göründüğünden bile daha güzeldi; ihtiyacımız olan her şey düşünülmüş ve eksiksizdi. Konumu, rahatlığı ve genel atmosferi sayesinde çok keyifli bir deneyim yaşadık.
Ev sahibi ise inanılmaz ilgili ve nazikti; iletişim her zaman hızlı ve sorunsuzdu, her konuda yardımcı oldu. Kendimizi gerçekten rahat ve güvende hissettik.
Kesinlikle tekrar tercih edeceğimiz ve gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye edeceğimiz bir yer. Her şey için çok teşekkür ederiz!

Convenient location if you’re passing through Sabiha Gökçen Airport and need a place to stay for the night.
The flat is best suited for a couple (instead of 4 people), as the sofa bed in the living room isn’t the most comfortable option. While pillows were provided, proper bedding was not, and we were given two throw blankets instead—manageable, though not ideal.
There was a noticeable smell of smoke in the space, which suggests smoking might be allowed indoors. If you’re sensitive to this, it’s worth considering before booking.

The host was extremely helpful, responsive and welcoming. We had all the information needed for our short stay, and they even left some snacks for our kids. Moreover, they organized our transportation, a man who was extremely nice, helpful and who brought us directly to the apartment. This is something that makes the stay in the place much nicer to overall. The apartment is nice and very clean. Although we stayed for one night only, we enjoyed and had everything we needed. The neighborhood is full of restaurants and people, but yet peaceful and calm. It is very very nice and just 5 minutes drive from Sabiha airport.

Kardeşimin mezuniyeti için ailemi gönderdim ve Ediz bey herkesinde bahsettiği gibi başından sonuna kadar herşeyiyle ilgilendi ve çok nazik ve samimiydi. Ailem 4 kişiydi, Ediz bey tuttuğum ilanda 3 kişinin rahat edebileceğini ama elinde 4 kişinin rahat edebileceği aynı daireden olduğunu iletmekle birlikte içimizin rahat edebilmesi için dairenin her adımını çekmiş olduğu uzun videosu sayesinde göstermiş oldu. Aynı zamanda tercihlerimize seçenekler sunarak saygılı bir yaklaşımla kaliteli bir konfor alanı oluşturmaya çalıştı ve başardı da 🙏 Dairenin bulunduğu konum itibariyle de her yere çok yakın ve ferah. Sonuç olarak hiç çekinmeden gönül rahatlığıyla kaliteli bir konaklama için burayı hiç düşünmeden tercih edebilirsiniz. Ediz bey herşey için yine ve yeniden çok teşekkür ederim..

description:
Experience a cozy stay in the heart of Istanbul!

This booking offers a stylish studio apartment on a tranquil street in Pera, with proximity to the famous Istiklal Street, prestigious Pera Museum and Soho House, historic Galata Tower, vibrant nightlife, and convenient public transit options, all just minutes away.

Featuring a useful private kitchenette, high-end essentials, daily cleaning, and concierge services, we ensure a memorable vacation!

reviews.text: Stayed here for a few nights with a friend, we booked this Airbnb because it had air conditioning, reviews noted it was super clean, and the price was fair. It was exactly as expected, the AC was better than another hotel we stayed at for the first part of our trip. The unit was very clean, the sheets are perhaps a bit worn (some balls from laundry/repeat use), but otherwise nothing really to note. Location is great in terms of location (close to Pera/Beyoglu/Galata), lots of restaurants and corner stores/small grocery stores nearby. We had trouble with the keyless check in but the host was on the premise and gave us physical keys right of way (so no issue in the end).

Had a pretty comfortable stay here. The place is located quite centrally and the room itself was quite clean and spacious.
The only issue I had was that the wifi didn’t work properly during the majority of my stay. It kept coming and going every 15-20 mins or so. Perhaps something for the host to look in to.
But other than this, this place is a great value for money and I would certainly recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul. It’s close enough to the main streets yet far enough so you can enjoy peaceful sleep.

I had an incredible stay at this Airbnb! The room was spotless, cozy, and had everything I needed for a comfortable stay. Having access to a fully equipped kitchen was a huge bonus, and the included room cleaning service was a thoughtful touch.
The location was absolutely perfect, just a 5-minute walk to Taksim Square, making it super convenient to explore the heart of Istanbul.
What truly made this stay exceptional, though, was the host Irem. She was incredibly kind and responsive, always replying to my messages within minutes. She even went above and beyond by helping us order food through Turkish online apps, which was such a kind and thoughtful gesture.
I highly recommend this host to anyone visiting Istanbul, her hospitality and the perfect location make this Airbnb an unforgettable experience. I would definitely stay here again!

This was my first time in Istanbul. I wanted to be close to Istiklal Street without the noise, and I was lucky to pick this studio.
The location was exactly what I was looking for—perfect!
If you enjoy walking, you'll be able to get to a lot of places from the studio.
The self check-in instructions and local recommendations were very clear.
I liked how the studio is furnished, and the whole building is very clean.
I highly recommend the place.

The photos match the reality.
The check-in was quick.
Istiklal is nearby for walking.
The apartment was clean and tidy.
I recommend it for a visit.

description: This spacious apartment in Şişli Center has 4 bedrooms, a bathroom, a kitchen and a balcony that can accommodate up to 9 people. This apartment, which is exclusively for our guests, has all the necessary kitchen utensils for cooking and eating. Thanks to its central location, this comfortable area is ideal for families, close to restaurants, cafes and transportation points. You can enjoy the city view from the balcony and have a home-like experience.

reviews.text: We loved the place. We were a family of 6 adults and the 4 bedrooms suited us well. The kitchen and living room areas are large and accommodated us well. We appreciated the extra half bathroom with so many people. It was very clean. The host was very responsive. The location was great, only a short 1-minute walk to the closest bus stop. It is on the 7th floor and has an elevator. I highly recommend this place for a larger group.

We had a great 6-day stay. The apartment was comfortable and the location in Şişli is unbeatable, with everything easily accessible. The internet wasn't working on the first night, but the host was very responsive, tried his best to fix it, and even kindly sent us a dish of baklava to make up for the inconvenience. The only downside was some street traffic and construction noise around the building during our stay. Still, the excellent location made it absolutely worth it. Overall, a very positive experience.

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was very clean😌, comfortable, and exactly what we were hoping for. The location in Nişantaşı was excellent and made it very easy to explore Istanbul. Our host was also very kind, helpful, and always quick to respond whenever we needed anything. We truly enjoyed every part of our stay and felt very comfortable there. If we visit Istanbul again, we would definitely love to stay here again. Highly recommended!🌸🙏

Ultimately I was not very impressed with the unit considering the price. The host was wonderful, I recommend him as a host. He was very responsive and did try his best to quickly remedy the issues. But during our stay the unit smelled like sewage starting day 2 and the smell never really went away. There is one full bathroom and one half, and neither of them had a vent inside the bathroom. The elevator also broke in the middle of the day, it took some time to fix it. Being on the 7th floor, it made it almost impossible to leave to come until it was fixed. The bed sheets, blankets, and towels were really, really old. We did ask for new bedsheets which they supplied shortly. I would recommend trying a different unit this host has, this one was 'Okay'. Next time I am in Istanbul, I will probably not stay at this unit.
Great host, responsive whenever you text. The place is great for the price. It is clean and the furniture is functional. Clean bathroom, kitchen and living room. It is near metro.

description: Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay.

reviews.text:
We had an excellent stay at Tunnel Suites Apartment. Reyhan is a wonderful host — she welcomed us personally to hand over the keys and was extremely kind and friendly. She speaks very good English and even tried some Spanish, which we really appreciated.
The apartment is exactly as shown in the photos. The bed is very comfortable, as is the sofa. The air conditioning works perfectly, and the shower is excellent.
A special mention to the café located just below the apartment, which is also run by Reyhan. We ate there a couple of times, and the food was absolutely delicious and very reasonably priced.
We truly loved the experience and highly recommend this apartment. It is located near Galata Tower and right in the heart of Istiklal, in the Beyoğlu district — a perfect location for exploring the city.

If you want to stay in a place that feels like home, stay at Tunel Suites. Throughout our stay, Reyhan and Nuri treated us like family...warm, helpful, available, and excellent communicators. The apartment was just as described in a great location, and equipped with basic bathroom and kitchen essentials. The washing machine is an added plus, which came in handy. I fell quite ill during my stay with food poisoning or a stomach flu, and Reyhan made sure I had everything I needed and more. We were also treated to dinner on the house one evening in their cafe downstairs, a really special touch for someone who hadn't been able to eat in over 24 hours!
There is occasional noise from construction in a building nearby, but that is to be expected given the central location. Otherwise, it is an amazingly peaceful respite just around the corner from the most bustling street in the neighborhood.
Thank you, Reyhan and Nuri. Your hospitality merits 5 stars!

One of the best airbnbs I’ve ever stayed in! Location was perfect. Three min walk to metro line, taxis available at doorstep. Restaurants, bars, cafes, shopping, convenient stores, historic landmarks all with walking distance. Hosts met us on arrival with keys, offered us coffee and refreshments, helped with baggage, showed us the apartment, gave us WiFi access, showed us how to operate ac and where to find extra linens, pillows, etc. The apartment itself was gorgeous. Well appointed, everything in working order, and super clean. The only thing I could see being a problem, although it did not bother us at all, was that the floors are wooden. So there was a little noise when upstairs neighbors walked around. Also it’s in a busy area of the city, so outside noise, day and night, is to be expected. It was not unbearable or obnoxious, just something to be aware of if you’re looking for a super quiet space. 10/10 would recommend. I only wish we had stayed longer! Will return!

Tünel Suite was an excellent place for us to stay! It is just a one-minute walk from Galata Tower, yet it is located on a quiet, private street.
The owners also run the coffee shop downstairs, where you are warmly welcomed with traditional Turkish tea or coffee. Reyhan is usually at the café and is incredibly knowledgeable, friendly, and willing to help with anything you need. Just ask her!
The suite is very clean and has a beautiful, modern European-style renovation. It is also well equipped with a washing machine, full kitchen, air-conditioning units, iron, and everything you need for a comfortable stay.
We had a wonderful experience and would definitely stay here again!

It was a special trip as it was my best friend's 40th birthday celebration.
We found this lovely airbnb apartment and when we arrived, it was peaceful and perfect place.
Hot water pressure is so good especially after a cold day outside. Alot of restaurants nearby and shops around. Galata tower and Taksim Square are just a couple of minutes walk.
Bed was comfortable with towels and the home is fully-equipped.
Public transportations are all nearby too so this is a perfect place to stay.
The host's cafe is also just downstairs next to the apartment's building and they are so friendly that it feels like we were friends for a long time! 😃😃
The host was so kind and patient to help us get a taxi a couple of times too!
We both like to thank Reyhan again for the warmest hospitality and great service throughout our entire stay, which made our Istanbul trip very enjoyable.
Highly recommend anyone to book this place.

description:
Welcome! This economical room offers you comfort in the city center. We are in the most valuable and safest area of Istanbul. Free tea and coffee are also available in the room. The linens come from a professional laundry service. Clean towels, shampoo, soap, everything is available.

Your room and bathroom are completely yours and you don't share them with anyone!

We are very close to Beşiktaş Marriage Office and you can easily come by public transport. We also have a parking lot.

reviews.text:
Kesinlikle önermiyorum. İlan fotoğraflarında gösterilen oda ile kaldığımız oda arasında ciddi fark vardı. Oda fotoğraflardakinden çok daha küçük ve son derece bakımsızdı.
Tuvalet kırık durumdaydı ve çevresi saçlarla doluydu. Tuvaletin dışındaki alan ise toz, kir ve idrar nedeniyle oldukça kötü durumdaydı. Genel olarak odada temizlik ve hijyen konusunda ciddi problemler vardı. Yatak çok lekeli ve aşırı gıcırtılıydı, havlular da temiz değildi. Odanın konforundan bahsetmek mümkün değildi.
Ayrıca bina içerisinde saatlerce çocukların koşuşturması ve yüksek ses nedeniyle de rahat etmek mümkün olmadı.
Ödediğimiz ücretin karşılığını kesinlikle alamadık. Hatta fiyat-performans açısından dahi kabul edilemeyecek kadar kötü bir deneyimdi. Bir gece bile kalamadan, yaklaşık 10 saat içerisinde konaklamayı sonlandırıp ayrılmak zorunda kaldık.
Temizlik, hijyen, konfor ve genel koşullar açısından kesinlikle tavsiye etmiyorum.

It was the worst place I went in my life. After booking, the host called me and asked me to pay more money so that she can deliver a good room. The room was dirty as it had not been swept and the sheets had not been washed. The bathroom well was blocked and the water was not flowing. The door lock was broken and would only close and not lock. The person who gave me the room did not know English and did not pay attention. There was no blanket in the room, only a thin sheet of bedclothes. It was in the basement.
I tried to contact the host Bebe replied till I went looking for location couldn’t find and had to book another hotel to stay. Very poor host and bad response

description: Stay just 400 meters from Taksim Square and Istiklal Street, in the heart of Beyoğlu, with easy access to public transportation, shops, cafés, and major attractions ,all while being on a quiet residential street. This private studio is ideal for solo travelers or couples seeking a central, comfortable base in Istanbul, with fast Wi-Fi, simple amenities, and self check-in for a smooth stay.

reviews.text:
The apartment is beautiful & spacious for 2 people, it has a nice outside private terrace. It was extremely clean & spotless.
If yours visiting in winter the place has central heating which will make you warm enough throughout your stay.
The location is perfect, it’s approximately 5 minutes away by foot from Taksim station (mostly flat), it has various markets around the apartment that contains anything you want.
The neighborhood is quiet & safe.
Check in process was easy, Sanaz & her husband Mustafa welcomed us with the keys.
Sanaz & her husband as hosts they’re very friendly, considerate & nice. They even left us a complementary drinks in the fridge. Sanaz is very responsive& proactive. Due to our long stay she even offered us new sheets & towels for free.
Overall the place is worth it, the host has a great sense of hospitality, totally recommend it & would visit there again.

+ warm Apartment
+ Location near to Taksim square
+ responsive host
+ quiet street (no noise of cars and you could hear less the noise of praying)
- restaurants in the surrounding are overpriced, so you better walk a bit outside of taksim to get a fair price

I really enjoyed the studio and the outside patio. The house were very helpful with many recommendations and they were all excellent. I specifically appreciated the walkability and this location. Istanbul has great public transportation, and this location as a base was very easy to navigate. I would also recommend staying at a place like this versus an overpriced hotel. The hosts were very flexible and responsive.

The apartment was exactly as on picture and described. Nice and cosy apartment right next to Taksim square. All restaurants, and shops are nearby. The host was great - responsive, helpful, and flexible. I would recommend this apartment to everyone.
Our stay at was very comfortable . Ideal location and center of Istanbul . Sanaz is friendly and accommodating host . I would recommend studying here. Her place was as described.

description: Take it easy at this unique and tranquil getaway.

reviews.text:
Very welcoming atmosphere. We were greeted with Turkish tea.
The room was just as described. Very clean and cozy.
We loved that Mr. Miller has a Market just opposit of the small street, so it was easy to get in touch if needed. also very responsive communication online. We had absolutely no problem.
We would love to come back another time.
The neighborhood is very lively and charming. Very local and not touristy at all. Many cafes and restaurants and local shops around, yet quiet when you are "home".

Oda fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi, mobilyalar yeni ve temiz. Ev sahibi her soruma hızlıca yanıt verdi ve yardımcı oldu. Marmaray’a 5 dk yürüme mesafesinde olmasıyla da merkezi bir yerde.
Rahat bir konaklama oldu, teşekkürler. Memnun kaldığım için yakın zamanda yine tercih edeceğim.

We had a great experience staying at this place.. I initially booked it for the location, as it is located just 7 minutes away from the big Yenikapi station (it houses the B1 line Marmaray that’ll easily take you to the Asian Side all the way to SAW airport, as well as M2 metro line to Taksim and more).
The room itself is clean and beautifully designed.. the kitchen was small but very well equipped. And we really love the balcony! The smart TV was a cherry on top as well. Not to mention that the hosts were very kind, responsive, and helpful.

The apartment was absolutely perfect – modern, clean, and fully equipped with everything we needed. The location was also very convenient. The host was incredibly kind and helpful, always quick to respond to our questions and made sure we had a comfortable stay. We really enjoyed our time here and would definitely love to come back again. Highly recommended!
Great location, clean apartment. Mr miller was very responsive and helpful! Great stay for a reasonable price! Thank you very much :)

description: Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay.

reviews.text: The location is great, the accommodation was far from great. It was run down, not like the photo's and appears not to have had any work done to maintain it. Specifically, we couldn't open and close the shower door, as the handles were completely missing from it (with holes of where they used to be) and the bathroom light had fallen down (the host kindly had these fixed and put on the following day). The little kitchen trolley (I'm guessing they're listing as a workspace or dining table?!) is broken with the legs having come away from the trolley. Much of the furniture in this place is really cheap, which is fine for an Airbnb but it means when guests break it, repairs/replacement are needed. The lounge was so stained/dirty/with cigarette hole that we didn't feel comfortable sitting on it at all. The place has the bare minimum. A hand towel/tissues or kitchen towel would have been useful. Note: the cleaner did a phenomenal job at cleaning. The issues we had were moreso with the upkeep.

The apartment matched the photos and description: clean, comfortable, stylish.
It has and ideal location: everything is walkable, great restaurants, transport hubs and supermarkets are nearby, but at the same time the street is very quite, what is rate for the city center! It felt very safe and peaceful.
The host was responsive and friendly. He even allowed us to check-in earlier.
It’s not a downside, but usually apartments always have tea and coffee, plus bottled water if it’s not advisable to drink tap water in the country. There wasn’t any in this flat, so we bought some tea and left it for the next guests. I think it’s a nice little extra for guests overall.
There are issues with the drainage system: a strong unpleasant smell is spreading throughout the flat. I think the problem is that this is an old, historic building, so it’s probably not that easy to fix, but it is definitely needed to install some air fresheners to mask the smell

Our stay was amazing from the beginning!
The apartment was easy to find, located in a nice and clean neighborhood with well-maintained streets. The check-in process was very smooth, and Miray was super kind and easy to communicate with ,everything was ready for us when we arrived.
The building was clean, and the apartment was spotless, cozy, and comfortable. It had everything we needed, especially in the kitchen — all essentials were available. There were also clean towels, tissues, and a fresh scent in the apartment, which made our stay even better.
The location was excellent, only about 5 minutes away from Taksim Square, and very close to everything we needed.
The price was fair and reasonable for a 10-night stay, definitely worth it.
Communication with Miray was great; every time we needed something, he responded quickly and took care of it. He even arranged a free airport taxi for us on our departure day, which was so kind.
I highly recommend this place for anyone visiting Istanbul

We really enjoyed our stay at Miray’s apartment. It was exactly as described, small but cozy. It’s comfortable for a couple, close to everything but at a very quiet and peaceful street. It’s conveniently located, 5-7 minutes walking uphill to Taksim square and 12 minutes downstairs to Kabatas ferry.
Host always replied within minutes to us, allowed us to check-in earlier and to keep our luggage after check-out.
The only suggestion is to improve kitchen a little bit. There are some basic appliances but very minimal. It would be great to have some paper towels, two water and wine glasses instead of one each

I stayed here for 4 nights and then extended another 2 nights. The place is a few minutes walking from Taksim Square. It's certainly much quieter here than other AirBnBs in this area. No traffic noise at all. Very silent. It's also save. The apartment is exactly as on the pictures. It's also very clean. In the basement is a free washing machine with 15 minutes option. The kitchen works fine. It's not big but good enough to cook your own food. WiFi is fast enough. This building has an elevator which makes it much easier to get your luggage to the apartment. I would book it again. Recommended

description:
Enjoy in a tranquil and conveniently situated flat, ensuring a straightforward and cosy stay. Merely a 8-minute stroll from Istiklal Street (450 mt away), yet remarkably serene and tranquil in contrast.
In just a few minutes, you can walk to many popular tourist attractions, cafés, restaurants, markets, and more.
You can walk to the Taksim square in 16 minutes (1 km), Galata Tower in 18 minutes (1.2 km), Karaköy pier in 28 min (1.9 km)

reviews.text: The place was very comfortable and clean, exactly as shown in the photos. It was located on the 4th floor and absolutely worth it. There was a lovely balcony facing a small park where I could watch cats and birds, which made the stay even more special. The apartment was fully equipped, including a complete kitchen and a cozy TV room, making it perfect for a longer stay. The location was also very strategic, close to bus stops and within walking distance to Taksim and Galata. The host was very responsive and helpful throughout my stay. Thank you, Furkan!

We had a really great stay. The place looked exactly like the photos, everything was accurate and well prepared.
All essentials were available and you can tell everything was done with care. The hosts were super helpful and responsive we had a small issue and it was fixed very quickly
the sofa was very comfortable, the place was quiet with no noise at all. The street is clean and feels safe, perfect for girls traveling. Plus, the location is amazing, just a 5minute walk from Istiklal Caddesi. Would definitely recommend

We had a wonderful stay and truly enjoyed our time here! The apartment was exactly as described — very clean, cozy, and thoughtfully prepared for guests. You can really feel the care and attention to detail.
The host was incredibly responsive, friendly, and helpful throughout our stay. Check-in was smooth and easy, which made everything even more comfortable.
The location is great and convenient, with everything you might need nearby.
We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and pleasant stay!

Great stay in Istanbul! The apartment was exactly as described — clean, modern, and very comfortable. Everything inside was new and worked perfectly. Check-in was smooth and easy. The host communicated clearly, responded quickly, and explained every detail we needed. I definitely recommend this place for anyone visiting the city.
Totally recommend! The space is comfortable and immaculately clean. The location is also perfect. Hosts were extremely helpful and responsive. Thank you for an amazing stay!

reviews.text:
The owner of the apartment:
very polite and attentive, always ready to help, always in touch. He met us, advised us on the best way to get from the airport. All agreements/wishes were taken into account. Regarding the check-out time, he allowed us to stay until 14:00 instead of 11:00, without any additional conditions. The impression is very positive.
The apartment:
exactly as in the photo. The entrance is at ground level (the "Russian" first floor, the "European" ground floor). Upstairs is a kitchen-living room, downstairs are two bedrooms and a bathroom. It does not seem so spacious in reality, but it is very clean, there are all the necessary things, including shower gel, toilet paper, salt, oil, etc. A powerful hair dryer, vacuum cleaner, washing machine - everything works. It is not hot on the ground floor, if the windows are open - the rooms have a comfortable temperature. There is air conditioning in the kitchen-living room. The accommodation was comfortable.

We had an excellent stay. The house was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location is perfect: only a 5-minute walk to the bus stop, about 10 minutes to maidan Metro Station, and very close to the HAVAbus airport shuttle stop, which makes getting to and from the airport very convenient. It is also a great option for elderly guests because of its accessibility.
The host was very attentive, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay. We highly recommend this accommodation for its cleanliness, convenience, and excellent location. Thank you for a wonderful stay!

Staying here was an absolutely wonderful experience. From the moment I arrived, everything felt welcoming, clean, and thoughtfully prepared. The apartment is exactly as described cozy, comfortable, and very well equipped, with everything needed for a relaxing stay.
The location is fantastic, especially for exploring Taksim and the surrounding areas. It felt safe, convenient, and full of life, yet the apartment itself was peaceful and comfortable after a long day.
What truly made this stay special was the host’s kindness and professionalism. Communication was always clear and quick, and I genuinely felt taken care of throughout the entire stay.
I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul. It combines comfort, great location, and excellent hospitality.I would happily stay here again.

This apartment is a great place to stay, especially for younger guests, as the bedroom and bathroom are located downstairs. If you're traveling with elderly individuals, it might not be the most convenient option. The metro station is within walking distance but not too close, so be prepared for a bit of a walk. The water heater works perfectly, and all necessary amenities are provided, which is a big plus. Additionally, there are plenty of stores nearby, making it easy to buy food. Overall, it’s a good place to stay if you're traveling with younger guests. The owner is very responsive and always ready to assist, which adds to the positive experience. This is an honest and unbiased review.

Overall, I had a great stay and would recommend this place. It’s remarkably quiet, on a street with almost no traffic, yet just a 5 minute walk to the bus stop, 15 minutes walk to Taksim Square. The layout is comfortable, with living space upstairs and two small bedrooms downstairs that are conducive to sleeping. The unit is very well-equipped with almost everything you might need. I was particularly impressed with the number of hangers in the closets.
A few notes: the stairs to the bedrooms are steep with low headroom. The address shown on Airbnb and in the link he sent were both slightly off and didn't include the building number, but Yuksel was proactive in making sure I found my way to the unit, so it didn't prove to be a problem, and he said he'd fix this.
While he is very responsive, he can also be overly eager with messages, asking the same questions or providing the same information several times for no apparent reason.
Still, I felt at home and would happily stay again.

description: The apartment building has a special location in the city, close to trade and shopping centers (Trump Towers and Cevahir mall), banks, cinemas, theaters and art centers. You can easily reach E5, one of the main transportation routes in Istanbul, metro and metrobus. Our facility has a washing machine, kitchen, microwave, oven, air conditioning, smart TV and refrigerator. Among the amenities offered are free Wi-Fi access and free parking.

reviews.text: Lovely place,looked just like the pictures😄 clean apartment,nice host. Thank you🙏🏼
Konum olarak oldukça merkezi aracınız için ücretsiz otopark alanıda bulunuyor. Osman Bey be diğer çalışanlar çok kibar ve yardımseverdi. Evin içi temiz ve topluydu.
Located in the heart of Mecidiyekoy, near Trump Towers; this area offers great access for those needing transportation and has a nearby parking lot.

Osman was very polite and understanding, and communication was smooth and easy, also very polite with good staff.
Also, the location has convenient access to shopping centers and public transportation.
The only thing I can say is that the place doesn’t have enough facilities — not even for two people, let alone five. In fact, it’s more suitable for sleeping five people than for actually living there. We were two people at first, and later three more were supposed to join us, but after two or three days we had to change our place.
Osman was very flexible and we could change our reservation.
Great location close to Metro, the communication and service from the staff was excellent - very accommodating for me and my family and our vehicle.

description: This special place is close to everything, making it easy to plan your visit.

reviews.text:
The apartment is in a beautiful area near Galata Tower, and overall it was clean, although the sofa bed had hair and small debris when we unfolded it. Communication with the host was difficult from the start: my check-in requests on Airbnb were ignored multiple times, and we waited 45 minutes outside until I contacted support and had to call the host myself. Only after that I received instructions via Whats App messenger.
We also had issues with heating and hot water — it was only lukewarm, and later one day it stopped completely. I wrote repeatedly on Whats App (the channel the host himself used before), but my messages were ignored for hours. When I finally wrote again on Airbnb, the issue was resolved, but the host told me I should have written there from the beginning, which was confusing. My family lost half a day unable to take a shower and enjoy the city due to unclear and inconsistent communication from the host.

The worst Airbnb I have ever stayed in. We arrived to find the apartment completely uncleaned: windows shut, a stench of cigarette smoke, and the previous guests' sheets still on the floor. We had to call Borek to let them know and then wait two hours past check-in. The person meant to help us was rude and unhelpful, and we never got so much as an apology.
The apartment itself is just as bad. "Clean" towels were wet. The sheets were covered in lint and pilling —we'd been camping before this, so this isn't about high standards. Two toilet rolls for six days, soap gone by day two, a disgusting toilet brush, and basically one pot in the kitchen. The floors are badly patched, there's damp throughout, and the bedroom windows won't even shut properly.
The photos hide all of this. It isn't someone's cared-for home. The building repeats the same untastef unit eight times over. It's a business, nothing more.
Airbnb is rotting. What I don't want for myself, I don't want for anyone else.

Host showed no care. I came at 6 PM and I had no check-in instructions - neither in the listing nor in the messages. I wrote to host, he sent me friends Whats App. I wrote. Noone replied. After messaging host again, I finally received the door code TWO HOURS AFTER my first message.
Dirty apartment. Towels had stains, one had a torn piece. Pillowcases and sofa were stained. Oven was dirty.
The shower faucet was leaking - and this was already mentioned in reviews.
There was a washing machine, but no washing powder/tea/salt/cutting board, even no toilet paper holder.
We asked for an extra blanket. Host said he would bring it, but no one ever did. We didn’t even bother reminding him - it was clear the host simply doesn’t care.
Worth to note:
• Very loud neighbors - children shouting early in the morning
• During rain the street literally turns into a river
• There was active road work right in front of the entrance during our stay, with a trench separating the entrance from the road

Burak was a great host. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and in an excellent location with easy access to public transportation and nearby attractions. Communication was easy, and he was always polite and helpful. Check-in and check-out were smooth. I would happily stay here again and recommend this place to other travelers. Thank you!

I had an absolutely wonderful stay at this property. From the moment I arrived, everything was as described.
Highlights:
Exceptional location — It’s right in the heart of Galata, with easy access to public transport, restaurants, shops, and cultural sites. It made exploring Istanbul effortless.
Charming design & ambiance — The apartment is thoughtfully decorated, with tasteful touches and cozy spaces that feel both stylish and comfortable.
Spotless & well-maintained — The place was clean, fresh, and everything was in good working order — appliances, plumbing, lighting, and so on.

Spacious, clean, and stylish apartment. Excellent communication works from the very beginning. Great location in the center of the Balat district. Delicious food is available on the same street. Close to public transport. The only downside is street noise until midnight, as the apartment is located on a street lined with cafes and restaurants. If you go to bed early, bring earplugs.

great place! very central in Balat neighborhood. nice people that work downstairs in the cafe that helped kindly. only issue is that its really noisy until around 11/12. afterwards its relatively quite. just a car or motor. the location is amazing! most central. sweet little street and the home was great. very comfi bed. great shower. sweet little balcony. all really nice !

I am so thankful to have found this spot! The host are magnificent caring people and the space was clean, well appointed and in a beautiful part of Istanbul. Located above delightful cafe. Elif, Ersin, Benjamin and Beğit thank you so very much for being such wonderful hosts! I look forward to seeing you all again.

Location is great, just 2 minutes from the bus stop and the T1 line. Most major tourist sites can be reached easily from Fener.
The apartment itself is super cozy and clean. The host, Alef, and her family are incredibly hospitable, one of the best stays I have ever had. They truly treated us like family.
I can’t recommend this place enough.

This is a wonderful flat in a really characterful part of the city. It was easy to get public transport to all parts of the city and the main tourist attractions. It was spotlessly clean and very comfortable with every facility you could need. The little balcony was such a boon - looking down on the streets at night with everyone out and about. It is a really lively/buzzy area.
It was also great to stop off in the morning or evening in the lovely cafe below for a tea or coffee and catch up with everyone 😁
Elif and all the staff in the café really looked after us. At the end of the of our stay we felt like part of the family!
I really recommend this cosy flat and would definitely stay here again.

description: Located in the heart of Kadıköy our modern apartment blends the city's energy with a peaceful atmosphere.Enjoy the lush green views from its spacious windows while being within minutes of Kadıköy's lively streets, popular cafes restaurants and the seaside promenade. Offering accommodation for up to five people,the apartment features two bedrooms, a Smart TV, high-speed internet,natural gas heating and air conditioning in the living room. Carefully designed, our home provides a comfortable stay.

reviews.text: Our stay at this Airbnb was amazing! The host was super communicative, offering great local tips and a smooth check-in. The place was stylish, clean, and cozy, with all the amenities we needed—comfy beds, fast Wi-Fi, and a well-equipped kitchen. The location was perfect, close to city attractions yet peaceful. The host’s hospitality made it truly special. Highly recommend!

Herşey için çok teşekkür ederiz İstanbul gibi bir yerde bu fiyata çok keyifli bir deneyimdi ev çok temiz konumu çok güzel dairede ihtiyacımız olan herşey vardı ve vapura metroya 5 10 dakika mesafede gönül rahatlığıyla tercih edebilirsiniz. Bir dahaki gelişimizde yine tercihimiz burası olacaktır.

We very much enjoyed our two-week stay. The apartment was clean and well-equipped for a family to cook, wash their clothes, etc. The host also provided a pack-and-play crib for our baby.
The location is, in my opinion, the best in Istanbul. From the living room window you get a clear view of Camlica Tower, and the garden across the street is beautiful. The area around the apartment is full of restaurants and cafes, and it is a short walk to buses, the metro, and the ferry.
The host is quick to respond if you need anything extra.
Finally, the apartment has A/C, but only in the living room. This did not turn out to be an issue for us, even on the days that were over 30 degrees C, because if you use the fans and open the windows the air circulation in the apartment is quite good. But just something to keep in mind.

This is a great little place in one of the bustling parts of Kadıköy. However, being right across from a church in a side street it is very peaceful.
3rd floor unit without an elevator but, easy to get up the stairs. Parking is a night mare unless you use a parking lot which will run around 1200 a day.
The unit had everything one would need, well decorated and clean. And, the host were very accommodating with my uncertain arrival time.
Would totally stay here again.

Great location, tons of restaurants, shops, and transportation options, safe and convenient. We had a long stay at Berk’s Airbnb we walked everywhere and food markets close by, and you can walk to the ferries in minutes. It was perfect to have two bedrooms, a kitchen, and the washing machine was a bonus. Berk was absolutely incredible if we requested anything, literally he would responded in minutes which we really appreciated

reviews.text:
Host is very kind and helpful, I got sent 2 locations for the Airbnb that were couple hundred meters apart which made everything confusing (update the one on Airbnb). Host was responsive so we fixed this by chat in the end 👍🏼
The place wasn't as clean as I hoped, there were some hairs and just general dirt and stains around, there was a smell especially in the bathroom.
The place is relatively old and needs a makeover and deep cleaning.
The water heater runs out of pressure multiple times per day and I have to manually increase the pressure myself to have hot water.
Overall the place is not bad, it has potential if fixed and it has a great location if you need to be in Umraniye for a bit. Also the price can be a bit better for what you get. It should be at least 20% less cost unless it's fully fixed and cleaned.
Thank you for having me stay here though, I appreciate it and this all comes from a place of love to help you make your Airbnb better 🙏🏼

The place is wonderful! Location is super nice. Its a few mins away from a pedestrian path with lots of shops, restaurants, and two metro stops. There are grocery stores and a bus stop right across and a lovely bakery underneath. Ercan is very helpful, friendly, and responsive. He even walked us around the area on the first day. The house is exactly as photographed, space is clean and all amenities are there. However there were some small cons, such as the hot water being finicky therefore you need to turn a knob everyday before showering (it wasnt bad, but definately a surprise on the first few days when we didnt know). The second thing was our wifi went out randomly, which left us with no wifi for about a day or two. (This one was a bit more frustrating with the timing as I had an online meeting the next morning). However, the overall experience of staying here was wonderful! We stayed for 2 months and it definately felt like home for us. Thank you Ercan!

Konakladığımız ev son derece temizdi ve görsellerdekiyle tamamen uyumluydu. Ailemle rahat ve konforlu bir şekilde vakit geçirdik. Evin konumu oldukça avantajlı; toplu taşıma durakları yakın, market, eczane, manav gibi temel ihtiyaçlara kolaylıkla ulaşılabiliyor. Sokağı sakin, gürültülü değil. Araçla gelmemize rağmen otopark konusunda sorun yaşamadık. Sokakta park yerleri genellikle dolu olsa da yakın çevrede ispark ve özel otopark alanları da mevcut. Ev sahibiyle iletişimimiz hızlı ve çözüm odaklıydı, eve ulaşmamıza ve giriş konusunda yardımcı oldu. Genel olarak memnun kaldık, gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye edebilirim.

I had a wonderful stay at Ercan's other Airbnb home in Ümraniye. Just like his previous place, this one was also clean, cozy, and thoughtfully designed. Ercan is a fantastic host—always responsive, friendly, and helpful. The neighborhood is quiet and safe, with easy access to public transport and local shops. I truly felt at home and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!

Konaklamamdan genel olarak memnun kaldım. Ev temiz, düzenli ve ihtiyaç duyulan temel olanaklara sahipti. Ev sahibi iletişim konusunda yardımcı ve nazikti. Konumu da oldukça kullanışlıydı ve giriş/çıkış süreci sorunsuz geçti. Güzel bir konaklama deneyimi yaşadım, gelecekte tekrar değerlendirebilirim. Teşekkürler!

description:
🏡 Premium Designer Apartment in the Heart of Moda, Kadıköy

Welcome to one of Istanbul’s most desirable neighborhoods!

Located in the heart of Moda, Kadıköy, this spacious and stylish apartment is the perfect base for families, groups of friends, business travelers, and anyone looking to experience the authentic side of Istanbul while staying just minutes from the city’s most famous attractions. You are in the heart of the city with all public transport, never stuck in traffic.

reviews.text:
This was an excellent stay. The location was extremely central plus had convenient access to all of Istanbul, as it was near all major transportation hubs. The apartment was elegant and comfortable. The hosts were polite and extremely responsive. We really appreciated it how thoughtful the supplies were. The kitchen and the bathroom were well-stocked. Everything was arranged very thoughtfully. Even a view! We travel a lot, and this was one of the best places. You could just relax and enjoy the trip. We stayed a week, and not a single complaint! Check-in was a breeze and the hosts were responsive and extremely helpful.
I don’t always write reviews, but I had to flag this place for future travelers. A real gem.

We stayed here for a family reunion. The place was convenient and spacious for us (5 adults) and a toddler, and was as described in the listing.
The location stands out amongst all else. Pretty close to many attractions, bars and restaurants in Moda, and public transportation is within 5-10 minutes. It’s pretty flat outside, and was convenient for our elderly parents to step out and explore the neighborhood. Can get a bit noisy during the weekends as expected, but it was quite enough in the bedrooms to allow us and our toddler to comfortably sleep through the night.
The hosts were very responsive and got back to us almost immediately when needed. We also had a change of plans, and decided to extend our stay for an extra week. We appreciated that they accommodated our last minute request despite their other commitments.
Would definitely recommend the place.

Extensive and spacious apartment with 3 bedrooms, very clean, furnished in a beautiful modern style with new furniture. Serdar was very helpful and could always be reached very easily. The apartment is in Moda, the vibrant part of Kadıköy with lots of great bars, but still is quiet. It is also a quick walk of only a few minutes to Kadıköy subway station and to Kadıköy port where the ferries to the European part of Istanbul depart from. We felt very much at home and at ease in the apartment!

Great location! Easy access to all tourist locations on the European side with a 7 min walk to the ferry (which runs frequently and best transportation to avoid traffic). Many excellent restaurants and shops that are not over priced like the touristy locations. Highly recommend for anyone visiting Istanbul. Host was amazing, communicative, and accommodative. The apartment was spacious and very nice. Would repeat the next time I visit Istanbul without question.
Very big, nice, clean,comfortable place you feel like home, definitely will come back to stay when we comeback to Istanbul. The host let us to have a late check out as our flight was late.

description: Spacious 3-floor apartment in the heart of Sultanahmet! Just 5 mins walk to Blue Mosque & Topkapi Palace. Features 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, 2 living rooms, and 3 small kitchenettes. Each floor is fully private with password access. Perfect for families or groups seeking comfort, privacy, and top location.

reviews.text:
This apartment was a wonderful place for our family to stay in Istanbul. Having three separate levels made such a difference—it gave the kids and parents their own space, allowing everyone to enjoy privacy, relax, and shower without feeling crowded, which is rare when traveling as a family.
The location is fantastic. We always felt very safe, and it was an easy walk to all of the major sights and restaurants in the Sultanahmet area.
The apartment itself was spotless, smelled fresh, had very comfortable beds with high-quality sheets, and was stocked with plenty of towels. Everything felt thoughtfully prepared for our arrival.
One of the biggest highlights was the air conditioning. We visited during the summer, and after staying elsewhere with weak A/C, we really appreciated how cool and comfortable this apartment was. Ufuk had the air conditioning running before we arrived, so walking into a perfectly cooled apartment after being out in the Istanbul heat was such a treat!!

Ufuk was a good host. The place is really confortable as such spacious. We have a problem with the bathroom of 3rd floor but was fixed with the help of Ufuk & the plumbers he hired.
The location is really well located, to 7 minutes walk quiet to Hagia Sophia Mosque and Sultanahmet Mosque.
The cleaning of the space are really good one, but it necessary But it is necessary to equip the kitchen more, since we required more kitchen utensils or equipment such as a microwave or coffee maker, and these supplies were precarious.
The communication of Mr. Ufuk was really kind as friendly the time that I need to communicate with him.
It's a place that I recommend to stay.

Perfect location for Sultanahmed area, quieter compared to the busy Blue mosque and Hagia Sophia area. Cafe downstairs is convenient with laundry and sundry shop nearby. Clean and comfortable space with all the essentials provided.

The accommodation was so lovely and spacious, each floor has its own bathroom, kitchen and living area.
Definitely worth the money and in a beautiful, peaceful location! The cafe right over the road was a perfect too with delicious food and really friendly owners :)
The host was really helpful and quick at responding and sorted an issue we had with our door within 30 mins.
We will definitely stay here again, it was perfect!

I highly recommend this Airbnb. The host was extremely helpful and accommodating. The location was perfect as it was walkable to all major attractions while placed on a quiet, peaceful street. The apartment includes three separate suites with each suite continuing its own kitchen and bathroom. Very clean and as advertised. There are plenty of authentic restaurants close by including an excellent bistro (Art Cafe) directly in front of the Airbnb. The bistro owner provided an extra layer of support as they helped with local recommendations and even arranged for an early flight to the airport for us. Next time we are back in Istanbul we will be re-booking this Airbnb.

description: Our facility is a 4-minute walk from Galata Tower, with a small kitchen in each room and a terrace where you can spend your free time with your guests, and a reception that is always open even during curfews. We have a transfer service (VIP vehicle to/from the airport to the facility. Breakfast is available for a fee, and there is a small kitchen, minibar and sitting or working area, TV and air conditioning in each room. Paid parking is also available.

reviews.text:
The host was communicative and helpful and the location was phenomenal.
The staircases leading up to the rooms were quite narrow especially with bags. There was also quite a bit of mold in the bathroom which came with a smell. The shower also did not have a hook for the shower head meaning it had to be manually held and there was a crack in the toilet seat.
However, for the price and location it’s hard to beat.

Muhammed is a very kind and gracious host who goes above and beyond for his guests. The apartment was clean and as described, well-located, and fairly priced. I would recommend this listing for anyone interested in exploring vibrant Beyoğlu and its neighbouring suburbs. I would happily stay again.

The location is great, very close to Galata Tower and easy to reach from the airport with two metro lines. The apartment was clean and matched the photos, thought they seem to have been taken quite some time ago. The place is fine overall but could use some maintenance and small improvements, like adding hangers in the bathroom.
Muhammad was very friendly, polite, responsive and professional.
Overall, it was a comfortable stay, thought with a bit of maintenance, it would be even better.

Perfect location with Cafes and restaurants nearby. The host organized a very comfortable airport shuttle for us and someone even stayed up until 1am to welcome us. The room is on the fourth floor with very narrow stairs. It was not quite the same as in the pictures. It really needs maintenance done.

Location is great, next to Galata tower , there's a lot of venues in the area. You can also get to the tram stop which is 5 minutes walk from the hotel. Host was welcoming. Though, the room could have been cleaned up a little better and plumbing repairs wouldn't hurt either. Overall, the hotel is worth staying since its rooms have necessary amenities that you possibly need.

description: You can have a nice stay in a perfect apartment in a very central location at the foot of the eagle statue.

reviews.text:
Since the building doesn’t have a main door, the street cats can come in and out of the building. As a result, the next morning we had to navigate cat feces in the building hallways left by the cats. Also, a large bag of trash was left in the hallway a few floors below which we had to pass. It didn’t smell nice, but not only because of the trash or feces. Since the apartment is on the top floor, it gets quite warm at night, but sadly, the air conditioning didn’t work (it was on but the fan didn’t make any audible noises)
We were warned that the bar was in a busy neighborhood and agreed to it since we’re were only staying for one night. However, we didn’t expect the balcony door to be hard / impossible to close. For some lucky reason we were able to close it when we came back to go to sleep but we weren’t able to replicate that the next morning.

This isn't your average "close to the city centre" place, it literally IS the city centre:)) The host was very responsive to our questions, and resolved a few minor issues rapidly. The shower pressure is better than most 4* hotels and earplugs are always a good idea when you want to be right in the middle of the scene. Steps away from the best food and just upstairs of a pub actually. We had a great time, many thanks!

reviews.text: Good host. Location is nice but sometimes got noisy. Walking distance to all you need. Definitely recommend
Location is very good - close to everywhere. 2 min İstiklal Avenue, 5 min Taksim Square (bus, metro). Nice place and friendly host.

extremely satisfied with my stay at Mert’s place. He was best at communication always trying to help. Location wise this place beats everyone close to Taksim Square, Metro and surrounded by beautiful shops and restaurants. Will definitely come back here next time
Great apartment, great location, responsive host. Highly recommended! Would book again!

Mon séjour dans cet appartement s’est très bien passé. Il est idéalement situé, à deux pas d’Istiklal Cd., du côté de Taksim.

Dans l’ensemble, j’ai passé un bon séjour et je recommande cet appartement pour son emplacement et sa facilité d’accès.

Daha önce birçok kez konaklama yaptığım bu otelde böyle bir uygulamayla karşılaşmamıştım. Otele giriş sırasında konaklama ücretine ek olarak 1.500 TL provizyon bedeli alındı ve çıkışta bu tutarın tarafıma iade edileceği belirtildi.
Ancak sonradan öğrendim ki bu ücret, konaklama süresince oluşabilecek olası hasarlar veya ek masraflar için alınan bir güvence bedeliymiş. Konaklamam boyunca herhangi bir sorun yaşanmamasına rağmen çıkış işlemlerim sırasında bu ücret bana iade edilmedi. Muhasebenin konuyla ilgilendiği ve ödemenin daha sonra yapılacağı söylendi.

Müşteri memnuniyeti açısından oldukça olumsuz bir deneyim yaşadım ve bu nedenle tekrar tercih etmeyi düşünmüyorum.

description: Modern 2-bedroom apartment in Moda, Kadıköy, located on a quiet street in a brand-new (2025) building. Features 1 double bed, 2 single beds, a bright living room, open kitchen, bathroom, and a balcony with a great view. Includes high-speed fiber internet, Smart TV, dishwasher, washing machine, iron, vacuum, and full kitchenware. Elevator available. Just a 5-minute walk to metro, ferry, and public transport—perfect for families or remote work.

reviews.text:
The apartment was very comfortable, as seen on photos, and in a great location.
It's on a quiet-ish residential street but around the corner you have many shops and restaurants. If you walk in the other direction, you'll be in Moda which was our favorite area. I highly recommend walking down Moda St all the way to the water for great views and a stroll by the water. There's a nice little supermarket right down the stree from the apartment which we visited daily. Also a nice coffee shop close to the supermarket.
The hosts were very responsive. The kitchen wasn't stocked well for cooking (we stayed for 3 weeks with a small child), so we had to request a few basics (which were delivered the same day!) and a few others we bought. Also, the shower is a bit funky and doesn't drain well, but that may be the case in many places in Istanbul. There was some construction noise outside from the next-door building but it looks almost finished.
Overall we enjoyed our stay and would come back!

This was the perfect stay in Kadıköy. First of all, the location: at a peaceful quiet street, but within close walking distance to the shops, bars and restaurants.
The apartment was newly renovated, with new furniture and fixtures, comfortable beds and linens, and pristine clean.
And to top it all off, a great, very available and proactive host, who was ready to greet me and help with the checkin, and anything else that was needed - from local recommendations to questions and directions.
I fully recommend it for your stay at this lively, unique neighborhood - with a great cost benefit.

Berk's place is perfect . In my opinion it is better than the photos, a specious living room, clean bathroom and 2 bedrooms. What I like about it that you can fully get black dark thanks to the blinds which helps me sleep better.
As a former Istanbul local, I can easily testify that the location is the best. It is quiet but walkable to the Istanbul's most popular and beautiful center Moda, walkable to the sea side and Kadikoy rihtim where you can access to the all local transportation.
And Berk and his friends are very responsible, proactive and friendly. We will definitely come back for our next Istanbul visit

Great stay overall. The location was incredibly convenient, just a short walk to the ferry pier and right by the Kadıköy food district, which made exploring and dining super easy. The place was very clean and well-maintained, and the check-in process was smooth and flexible. Would definitely recommend for anyone looking for a comfortable and well-located spot.

Honestly a great place. Clean and tidy with all the kitchen amenities. Shower was great and beds were comfy. Hosts were really helpful and responsive - if I’m in this side of Istanbul again I would absolutely book it again.

description: It is located in the heart of Istanbul. Within a few minutes' walk, you will find Galata Tower, Galata Port Taksim Square, Istiklal Street, Kılıç Ali Pasha Mosque, Istanbul Modern Art Museum, many restaurants, pubs, shopping centers nearby. If you want to live in a central, historical neighborhood with the magic of old Istanbul, this apartment is for you. The perfect place for a city trip. Galata is a great choice for travelers interested in food, city walks and culture.

reviews.text:
I would not recommend you stay here under any circumstances.
Upon arrival we noticed the room had a strange odour, there were no blinds in the bedroom, and the bed itself was broken. Impossible to sleep in. I got in touch with one of the hosts who initially tried to convince us to sleep on the broken bed, and didn’t offer any alternative until I insisted the situation was unacceptable. The following afternoon one of the hosts came over and fixed the bed.
There are two windows in the bedroom, neither have curtains or blinds. You’d get woken up as soon as the sun would rise. It was impossible to sleep in.
The shower didn’t drain the entire duration of our stay. We couldn’t use it on the last night due to worries of the shower overflowing and flooding the flat.
The only positive from our stay was the location - it’s in a very nice part of town with a couple cool bars only a couple minutes away.
The hosts were responsive, but the state of the flat was simply unacceptable.

Evin konumu harikaydı. Istedigimiz her yere kolayca ulaşım sagladik. Mobilyaları fotoğrafta görünenin aynısıydı. Ama en büyük sorunumuz temizlik oldu. Ev sanki hiç iyi bir temizlik görmemiş gibiydi daginik değildi ama parkenin ve halinin uzun zamandır temizlenmediği açıktı. Banyoda ki kıllar bizi çok rahatsız etti ilk giridgimiz gece banyoyu temizlemek istedik ama temizlik malzemesi bile yoktu kendimiz sipariş verip banyoyu güzelce temizledik. Tozlar rahatsız etti. Ev temizlik standartlarına uysaydı bir daha tercih etmeyi çok isterdik.

Firstly, location was good and easy to find. There were many amenities nearby.
For the homeowner, he was very kind to us and responded very quickly. He made a point of fulfilling our requests immediately.
Secondly, there were some shortcomings. The table in the photos was not on the balcony. The house was not as clean as I expected, and it was smaller than it was showed in the photos. There were amenities like plates, glasses, or pots for cooking or having a drink, but there was no dish soap for cleaning up afterwards.

İki kişi olarak bu konaklamada 1 gece kaldık ve genel olarak iyi bir deneyim yaşadık. Konum gerçekten çok iyi — Tophane tramvay durağına sadece birkaç dakikalık yürüme mesafesinde ve merkeze hızlıca ulaşılabiliyor. Balkon da oldukça keyifliydi.
Özellikle ev sahibiyle iletişim çok olumluydu: her zaman nazik, sorunsuz ve yardımseverdi.
Geliştirilebilecek birkaç nokta vardı. Mutfak oldukça basit donatılmıştı ve bazı mutfak gereçleri eksik olduğu için daha çok kahvaltı veya küçük öğünler için uygundu. Ayrıca giriş yaptığımızda daire beklediğimiz kadar temiz değildi. Ancak istersek temizlik yapılabileceği belirtildiği için bunun daha çok temizlik personeliyle ilgili bir durum olduğunu düşünüyoruz.
Daire biraz ses geçiriyor; üst kattaki komşuların sesleri duyulabiliyor ve zemin yer yer gıcırdıyor. Ayrıca odalar fotoğraflarda gerçekte olduğundan biraz daha büyük görünüyor.
Buna rağmen ev sahibine teşekkür ederiz.
Great location, good restaurants nearby and also convenient store. Most importantly hosts were really friendly and helpful. And the place is clean and quiet. Definitely a 5 star place.

description: This trendy place offers many attractive details.

reviews.text: Great location, very clean and comfortable room. The staff was friendly and helpful, always ready to assist. Amazing view and easy access to public transport and main attractions. Highly recommended for a pleasant stay in Istanbul!
