description:
Stay at D Twins Airport Hotel, one of the closest hotels to Istanbul Airport, and enjoy a comfortable private room with a private bathroom.

The room includes:
- large bed
- TV
- Free wifi
- private shower
- free shampoo, shower gel
- hot water
- a kettle, coffee, and tea
- daily free housekeeping

Guests can relax in the hotel’s green garden and enjoy peaceful area views.

The hotel also features a restaurant where you can have meals and drinks, as well as a 24/7 reception.

reviews.text: If you’re transiting/layover in Istanbul, and need a place near the airport look no further. It’s two stops on the metro from the Airport with a 5 minute walk from the metro to the hotel. Excellent and convenient. And a great price great location. Absolutely saved my trip as there was a last minute change and I had to stay one night in Istanbul. FANTASTIC value and very close to the airport. PERFECT!

Very good room if you need to stay a night or two. Friendly stuff, clean towels and bed linen. Very close to airport.
There is little resto on site yet you can walk to a corner cafe for more affordable option. Overall a good experience.

Berbat bir deneyim yaşadım konu sahiplerden ilgi alakadan bağımsız fakat bir gece dahi rahatça konaklayacağınız bir yer değil odalar çok ama çok küçük eşyalar özensiz ve temiz değil sıcak su yoktu havalimanına sanıldığı kadar da yakın elverişli yer de değil bir daha muhtemelen tercih etmem tavsiye de etmem işletmemin geliştirmesi gereken çok fazla alan var kar edeceğim derken rezil olmayın
Really easy to get to from the airport, the reception staff were very friendly and helpful. The room was also just like the pictures. I enjoyed my stay and definitely recommend it.

The guy is so bad. He scams every guest, and his rooms are small and dirty. Really, I do not recommend, for the same price, you will get another place 100 times better. This place is not worth it room are small and dirty

description:
The apartment with a balcony is located in one of the most tourist-attracting districts in the world, in the center of Beyoğlu, within walking distance to Karaköy coast, Taksim Square and Galataport.

It is in an area where 24/7 transportation is easily available, you can reach all personal needs within walking distance, and you can access all social areas according to your preferences.

I offer you a space where you can stay and feel like you are at home

reviews.text:
We stay for a week there.
What is good:
* really clean space
* good location in downtown
* great communication with host
* comfortable bed
What is have to be improved:
* we met ants in the room and host told us to use spray
*the next day he invited exterminator. We’d have to wait for their visit. I think it is better to call them before guests check in.
* they left some powder on the floor of the whole apartment - this could be risky for kids and animals
* some kitchen stuff looks broken or old
* some scratches and spots on the walls.
Other peculiarity’s:
* narrow stages to the second floor - not for seniors and disabled people
* hills in the neighborhood- it is Istanbul, no flat places
* mosque starts praying it 4:00 am with a huge noise
* cruise ships in a Galataport was beeping in a random time
* roster screaming all the time on a street.
It is really noisy to sleep.

Very convenient location. Just a few blocks from a tram/bus station. Plenty of grocery stores and good restaurants in the area. The building is in a quiet block though.
The apartment is very good. The bedroom and the living room are of a good size and comfortable. The king size bed is a plus. The bathroom is also very good and has washer. The kitchen is a little small but still good. It also has a small balcony.
It is important to be aware that the stairs to get to the apartment in the second are very steep, so if you have heavy luggage and have mobility problems it may be a challenge.
The host is very helpful and responsive.
The apartment is definitely a good base to visit Istanbul.

Faith’s apartment is clean and tidy, with complete amenities. It has a large living room and bedroom, plus a small kitchen, balcony, and bathroom. The sofa in the living room can be pulled out into a bed—perfect for lying down and watching TV comfortably. We had a truly memorable stay here.
Within about a ten-minute walk, you’ll find subway and tram stations, as well as several large supermarkets, making it very convenient for buying food and daily necessities. The appliances, like the washing machine, only have Turkish labels, but you can use ChatGPT for guidance. We’d suggest the host provide some instructions for the apartment’s facilities. Istanbul has many winding side streets, so first-time visitors should pay close attention to directions when arriving.

We had a pleasant stay at Fatih’s place. The apartment was cozy, had everything we needed, and the air conditioning was especially appreciated during the hot Istanbul summer. The location is very convenient, within walking distance of the tram, metro, Galataport, and Istiklal/Taksim. Fatih was easy to communicate with and helped arrange our airport transfer, which made our trip more convenient. Overall, a good place to stay.

I had a wonderful stay at the apartment. It is very spacious, stylish, and perfectly clean. It has everything you need, which also makes it perfect for longer stays.
The internet is fast and works flawlessly, so I was able to work without any issues during my time there. There’s also a lovely balcony — perfect for enjoying a coffee.
Whenever I had a question, I could contact Fatih at any time. He replied immediately and was very friendly and helpful. Thank you, Fatih — I really enjoyed my stay.

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
Our stay in Istanbul was great, and we really appreciated the host's hospitality! He was incredibly kind and helpful (he carried our suitcases upstairs for us when we arrived) which was a huge help since the entrance is quite narrow. He was also very responsive and easy to communicate with too.
​For future travelers, it’s helpful to know that the apartment is a bit more compact than it appears. It works for 4 people, but the setup consists of one separate bedroom for 2 people, and two beds located in the living room area with open kitchen. Overall, it’s a simple base for exploring the city, made much smoother by a helpful host.

Location is good and the bathroom is clean. Very good price the staircase are very narrow and small especially if an older people goes to the third floor is very difficult. Also the Wi-Fi is not strong enough on third floor. It keeps dropping and disconnecting the Internet finally the cooking pot are very old and the kettle is not clean. The teapot is not clean. There is no knife for cutting vegetables or fruit. Generally I enjoyed it

Very comfortably located for those who prefer old town and Hagja Sofia area, the owner was extremely helpful and nice, the place itself is fine, worth the pay, the only thing is that internet connection was troublesome in case if someone has to work like me:) the rest is totally fine we will consider to return. Thanks!

The apartment was much smaller than expected. There were a lot of bed bugs everywhere, which made the stay extremely uncomfortable. The bathroom had no ventilation fan, and the balcony door glass was broken, allowing both cold air and outside noise to come in.
The balcony was full of junk, looked abandoned, and was very dirty. The apartment door had a hole in it, so you could hear noise from outside, and it never felt properly sealed or secure.
The bathroom was not clean and there were no cleaning supplies provided. I contacted the host through Airbnb to request cleaning, but they never responded.
There were blood stains and dirt on the mattresses, which was completely unacceptable. This was one of the worst apartments I have ever stayed in, and I do not recommend it at all.

The room was comfortable, matched the photos and description, and could house 4 people comfortably.
We had to check in at 2:30AM due to flight delay, but the host was very accommodating and we were able to check in without a glitch.
Husni the housekeeper was also super friendly and helpful, and helped us with our laundry.
The house is located on a small street with very cute, colorful houses, and near 2 beautiful little parks. It’s within walking distance to tourist attractions and public transport.
We are very pleased with our stay and would recommend this place.

description: You can get here by metro, metrobus, bus, and all public transportation... You will love Yeter Caddesi... It's a great location. There is no breakfast. The room price is for one person.

reviews.text:
The stay was overall very good, and I can honestly say everything was almost perfect.
The only small issue was with the location on Google Maps, which led me to a slightly different spot at first. Because of this, I had a bit of difficulty finding the place initially and had to contact the host, who kindly helped me and came to meet me. After that, everything was clear.
Apart from that, everything was excellent. The host was very friendly, helpful, and welcoming. They even offered me food, which I appreciated, although I had to decline because I had recently undergone dental surgery.
Communication was smooth, and everything matched the description exactly. All promised amenities were provided.
I also felt a strong sense of trust from the hosts, which created a very comfortable and positive atmosphere.
Overall, the accommodation is definitely worth the price, and I highly recommend it. If I come to Turkey again, I would gladly stay here once more if it is available.

We had a wonderful stay! We were warmly welcomed, and everything was cozy, comfortable, and clean. The hosts were very friendly and kind, and we felt really welcome throughout our stay. Everything was great, especially considering the affordable price. We really enjoyed our stay and would happily come back again!
Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and well located. The host was very friendly and responsive. Highly recommended!

I had a wonderful stay here! The host is an incredibly kind, generous, and welcoming person who was always willing to help with anything I needed. He made me feel comfortable from the moment I arrived. His little son is also absolutely adorable, and the whole family has such a warm and loving atmosphere.
The room was spotless, comfortable, and equipped with everything I needed. I truly appreciated how clean and well-prepared everything was.
Thank you for making my last day in Istanbul such a pleasant and memorable experience. I highly recommend staying here if you’re looking for a cozy place with a warm-hearted host. 🤍
Great host. Good communications. Room exactly as described. Recommended

description:
Conveniently set in Istanbul, Homelike Hotel provides air-conditioned rooms, a restaurant and free WiFi. The property is located 2 km from Istiklal Street. The accommodation features a 24-hour front desk.

All units at the hotel are equipped with a TV with satellite channels and a safety deposit box. The private bathroom is equipped with a shower, free toiletries and a hairdryer. At Hotel each room include towels

Popular points of interest near the accommodation include Istanbul Taksim Square.

reviews.text: Everything was exactly as described The place was clean well-organized and very comfortable Gökhan was very helpful and provided clear instructions and guidance throughout our stay. Considering the price it offers excellent value for money I would definitely recommend this place

Amazing location and amazing host ,
Helped out with late check out , held luggage for me , super accommodating. Location is amazing , astonishing shopping, metro , Taksim .. everything you need in just few steps . i will be back again :) .

description:
Enjoy a comfortable stay in the heart of Istanbul's historic Old City. Perfect for families and groups, this spacious apartment features 3 bedrooms, a cozy living room, and air conditioning in every room.
🛏️ Each bedroom has its own private bathroom and toilet, offering extra comfort and privacy for all guests.

Free Wi-Fi, a fully equipped kitchen

📍 Just a short walk to Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace, Basilica Cistern, the seaside, tram stations, and public transportation.

reviews.text: I stayed here for more than two weeks and had a great experience. The apartment is located in a popular tourist area with excellent access to public transportation, restaurants, and grocery stores. The listing description is accurate, and the apartment is well-equipped with almost everything needed for a comfortable stay. Celal is a wonderful host, always responsive, helpful, and easy to communicate with. During my stay, he even offered fresh towels and a cleaning service, which was greatly appreciated. Overall, it was a very pleasant stay and excellent value for the price.

First of all I would like to thank Celal for hospitality. Celal was very friendly and responded quickly. The apartment is situated in a very nice location. Walkable distance to many popular places such as Sultanahmet mosque and Topkapi palace, Gulhane park and Bosphorus. Three separate bedrooms each with its own bathrooms. I don’t like to give negative reviews, however the apartment really needs a professional housekeeping. It was messy when we arrived, the kitchen was not cleaned properly, the floors and bathrooms were dirty. The furniture, linens and towels were very old. This is the only negative thing about the apartment, but overall it is a good place to stay.

Everything was great, from the location to the place itself. The host gave us a warm welcome and took great care of us throughout our stay. We would highly recommend this place and would definitely stay here again.
They were helpful and great central location

The hosts were extremely friendly, helpful and accommodating. They assisted us with all kinds of queries, requests and even last minute extensions to our stay. We are extremely grateful to Cilal, Hamza and Ismael for their kindness, generosity and excellent service and will book another stay with them when we are back in Istanbul.

An ideal choice for a refined and well-connected stay in Istanbul.

Great host and great apartment - highly recommend, Im definitely coming back during my next visit
Konaklamada daire çok güzel ve temizdi. İletişim son derece hızlıydı. İhtiyaç durumunda anında dönüş yaptılar. Oldukça memnun kaldık. Sonraki ihtiyacımızda mutlaka tekrar konaklamayı düşünüyoruz.

description:
With 24/7 transportation, you can easily reach every corner of the city and discover shopping, entertainment, and beach walks within minutes.

I provide comfort where my guests can feel at home and 24/7 reception support.

reviews.text: Ulaşımı kolay, konum açısından da avantajlı. Fotoğrafta ki ortam ile tamamen aynı, girişte zorluk yaşamadık. İletişim&ulaşılabilirlikte gayet kolay ve basitti.

There were some issues with our place but Ugur quickly provided solutions. We were able to have a peaceful rest for our 24 hour layover in Istanbul. The location is convenient. We used the transportation Ugur provided from and to the airport which was great.

Fiyatına göre başarılı, sadece ufak tefek eksikleri vardı. Ancak ilgileri gayet iyiydi. Sürekli bişeye ihtiyacımız olup olmadığı soruldu. Uğur beyin her ulaşılabilir olmasıda ayrıca artıydı. Teşekkürler.

description:
Our design is in three words: comfortable, simple and clean. Our house is located in the heart of Istanbul, Beyoglu where you can find whatever you want about the culture and so on. Plus, it has quiet and local neighborhood. It is near Besiktas, Nisantasi and Fatih.


To summarize:
+ 1 min walk to tramp station
+ 1 min walk to bus station
+ 5 mins walk to metro station

We share our lovely terrace with our neighbours, so there are some restricted rules which I will inform you about.

reviews.text:
Great home! Even though it is on a lower level, it gets plenty of sunlight in all the rooms. The artwork and design of the home is a wonderful touch.
The patio upstairs is often empty,
So it’s a quiet place to relax and view the Bosphorous.
The bathroom is super renovated and nice (not something you always find in the old homes of Istanbul). Shower always has hot water.
Everything you need is in the kitchen.
Clean home.
No Air conditioning, but this is very normal for Istanbul. Open a window and you’ll be just fine. :)
Loved my stay here!! Super helpful host.

The hosts are great, but honest reviews of apartments are important for me, so I’ll write about the pros and cons
1. Cons.
1. The neighborhood is NOT quiet. The apartment is located near a school and every single morning a school bell wakes you up at around 8 o’clock.
2. The toilet flush breaks down all the time.
You always have to fill a bucket of water and pour it into the toilet. Definitely NOT what you expect from a 1000 dollar/month room in a shared apartment.
3. I saw cockroaches in the kitchen.
Pros.
1. Good location. 7 min walk from Taksim
2. Clean. Betty cleaned herself, took out the trash.
3. Betty was helpful and accommodating generally. She did the cleaning and sometimes washed my dishes, which I’m grateful for.
4. Good internet. Fast enough for my zoom conferences.
5. There’s a supermarket, metro and a barber shop nearby.
Cosy and clean apartment in the heart of Istanbul near Taksim Square. Good and responsive host, comfortable place for freelance and remote work .

Seren is a wonderful lady who made my stay in Istanbul a fantastic one..
I had a warm welcome
the room was ready clean and very comfortable.. she gave me a separate key for the apartment
I loved the terrace she had....especially in the morning with a cup of coffee or tea looking to Istanbul both Europian Asian parts on the bosphorus sea.. magical
I was using her house freely
the kitchen bathroom ironing washing.. like home
it is 6 min aways from Taksim square
Seren Room is highly recommended for anyone looking for such a room in Istanbul
I will definitely stay at Seren house next time I come to Istanbul because of all that I have mentioned above and also for the wonderful Seren

The place is located centrally in Taksim, close to many great places with just a few minute's distance. I liked the design and cleanliness of the apartment.
The balcony on the top floor has a great view of the city and Kiz kulesi which you shouldn't miss. I wish the internet was a bit faster but otherwise, I had a great stay.
Seren is very friendly and accommodated my check-in very well. Thanks for such a nice stay!

description:
It is 3-5 minutes walk to the metro, tram,bus stops and is quite central place.
It is located in a calm and calm neighborhood.

reviews.text: Good location, very clean and comfortable place. Hilal is awesome host, we spent much time watching movies to the deep night in friendly atmosphere. Highly recommended place to stay.

I stayed in Hilal apartement during my 1st stay in Turkey, she is a lovely person, with a big heart, she is also very helpful, she helped me a lot during my stay, if I come back to Istanbul I will probably stay with her,if she accepted me again ;) the apartment is well located, and Near of tram T1.
I recommend it
thank you very much Hilal :)
Hilal is one of the best host I have had, she's so helpful, responds really quick and assist as much as she can. And her place is really clean!

description: Charming two bedroom spacious 120sq m. apartment with high ceilings and lots of natural light in the great location of Cihangir. Close to all transportation links, restaurants & cafes.

reviews.text:
Stay was great! Host communicated well with clear instructions (might have been better if pictures of the lock was provided).
Location is good, a short 5-10 mins walk from Taksim and 10 mins walk to tram station that leads you to the tourist hotspots (Hagia Sophia, etc)
However please note!! The apartment is located on a hill, so please expect to climb a LOT of stairs, especially from the tram station. It is close to 5 mins of pure stairs, it should be manageable if you're moderately fit.

We loved our stay at this apartment in Cihangir! We stayed for three weeks and enjoyed getting familiar and comfortable with the neighborhood. The location is ideal — quiet, but nearby many great restaurants, shops, and major sites. The WiFi was excellent, supporting two people working from home on frequent simultaneous video calls. The apartment was clean, the towels and bedding were good. Vng management was very responsive and helpful throughout. Highly recommend.

Great place, quiet area, close-by stores for fruits and water.
The apartment is walking distance to the tram and that is useful to move around the European side and to the Sulthanamet area.
The apartment is clean, spacious and had comfortable beds. The host was very responsive and easy to communicate with. Definitely recommend it!

The flat is exactly like in the photos. Everything was amazing and I recommend to book it by everyone who wants to explore Istanbul. The beds were big and comfortable. Area was calm and you could sleep easily there. In a walking distance was a tram station and subway. Kitchen was fully equipped and everything was clean.

We loved staying at VNG property for the fact that it really is what you see on descriptions and photos! The house is so spacious, bright and located in the perfect location. I was concerned that the building didn’t have an elevator, but after arriving I found out we didn’t even need an elevator. It’s located right on the first floor! It was very convenient for us to stay with our 1 year old son, easy to move around with the stroller! Very nice breakfast places and dining places nearby! Super close to Taksim!
Overall, it was the best Airbnb experience! Kitchen has everything you need!

Our apartments in Şişli, the center of the European Side in Istanbul

reviews.text:

Also all the walls in the shower were covered with black mold. There was no toilet paper.
The bed was very uncomfortable because the springs dug into the back.
Wifi was very slow - less than 1 mbit\s.
Well, the biggest downside is the smell. Terrible smell of cigarettes, some mustiness and God knows what else. Our things smelled of this smell.
This was the worst rental experience ever. In addition, the price was far from the lowest.
Nice location, clean, wide and discounted price was great. AC wasn't strong and one of the shower doors didn't close other than that it was pretty good.

The place is ok if you can stand the loud music in the bar directly next door, which starts at midnight and doesn't end until approx 5 AM. My colleague in the room next door had the same experience but worse, as she had no hot water to shower the whole time we were there.
If you don't mind sleeping through extremely loud music, this is the place for you, but definitely not for me.

reviews.text:
Only 3 blocks away from Taksim Square (major transportation hub), the location is tucked in an apparently not well known street, as several taxis had difficulty finding it (in spite of it being marked on Google maps - I had to navigate them with my own Google maps). The apartment is on the 2nd floor (Europeans count the ground level as floor 0) of an old building. After climbing a narrow a staircase (about 30 steps), the apt itself is remodeled. It sits on 2 floors with an inner narrow staircase. Off the entryway are 2 spacious bedrooms with a queen size bed each, a living room, a tiny (1 person) kitchen reasonably well equipped (no microwave, no pot, -only a pan for cooking), 1 bathroom with shower. On the upper floor is a bedroom with a single twin-size bed, and a roll-away cot, a bathroom (no shower), and a dining room which we did not use.
The neighborhood has supermarkets, many places to eat. On Taksim square (5 mins walk) are many taxis, a metro/underground that connects Taksim Square to Kabatas, where the T1 tram line starts, that goes to Sultanahmed where all the main monuments are. It's the quickest way to get there instead of taxi due to traffic (and much cheaper). Also a couple of blocks away from Taksim Square is the stop of the HavaIST (the shuttle bus from the new IST airport (which just replaced the old Ataturk airport)) or HavaBUS (the shuttle bus from the SAW airport). It is the best way to come from/to the airport even with luggage, if you are able to walk a few blocks with your luggage. I found out the hard way that taxis refuse to give rides for short distances (even when it rained and I didn't want to walk with luggage), so don't plan on getting a ride from the shuttle stop to this apt.
The apt itself is well equipped, but we had to ask lots of questions on WhatsApp (which Nursena replied to immediately - thank you!) on how to turn on the hot water, how to operate the TV (local programming in a different languages, interesting to learn about local issues). It would be helpful to have a binder with all this info (or post them online) including the metro/tram/local restaurant recommendations/etc.
All in all, I would have preferred to stay in Sultanahmed area as we found ourselves going back and forth there every day. If you want nightlife, then Taksim Square area is probably better.

Nursena was very responsive to our questions and needs. We got there a few hours earlier than expected and she let us leave our luggage at the apartment while it was being cleaned. That help free is up for getting something to eat while we waited. This is the first apartment I have ever had while in Turkey that had a washer AND a dryer. The location is excellent, very close to restaurants, Taksim square and the metro station that takes you close to all the attractions in the old part of town. It is clean has lots of beds and has a quaint feel. The apartment is on the 3rd floor with no elevator and steep stairs. Once in the apartment it is on two levels, again with steep stairs. If you are comfortable with that it won't be a problem though. The showers are quite small and it was hard for one of the couples with us to shower in them. Overall the location, dryer and host were the top factors.

It was alright for 7 people (2 bathrooms with showers), beds were comfortable with clean sheets, also there was a living room with a big table so we could sit together after a long day of sightseeing. The host was very communicative, replied immediately and was very helpful :)
My only complaint is that there wasn't enough soap, shower gel etc. But I think it's because the cleaning lady had a very limited time to clean up so it's not a big deal (big shoutout to her for showing us how to open the door <3).

Positive aspects:
*Communication with Nursena was excellent — she was very responsive and provided us with clean towels upon request. She also checked in on us after the earthquake.
*Check-in and check-out were smooth — Nursena allowed us to leave our luggage for two hours after check-out and provided clear instructions for self check-in.
*The apartment had all the amenities as described.
Areas for improvement:
*Without going into specifics, we believe the cleanliness of the upstairs bathroom could be improved. It seemed as though it had been overlooked by the cleaning staff. Unfortunately, we did not bring this to Nursena’s attention during our stay, but we are confident that she would have taken action had we done so.
*While the apartment’s location is generally excellent, being close to Taksim Square, the immediate surroundings are less pleasant. For solo female travelers, we would recommend taking a taxi after 10 PM for added comfort and safety.

Great location!! Close to the local metro and other transport stations. Plenty of shops, restaurants and very close to Istiklal Street. A very lively area and all the neighbours were friendly and welcoming.
Nursena addressed any and all enquiries immediately which was great. The apartment was very clean and the air conditioning on the lower floor was a God send during the hot summer. Be prepared to carry your luggage up and down two narrow staircases because it was a bit of a struggle. All in all an enjoyable stay.
Top tip 1: there is a free shuttle bus that leaves Taksim Square at 0930 that takes you to Aqua Dolphin water park.
Top tip 2: There is a small takeaway down the hill and on your first right from the apartment that does the most amazing falafel wrap.
Top tip 3: The local Ferhat shop for the basics is open 24hr but is a little more expensive than mainstream supermarkets but convenient non the less.

description: If you are planning a nice vacation in the comfort of your home, our apartments in Büyükada, which are within a 3-minute walking distance to the pier, offer you, our valued guests, the pleasure of having a nice vacation in Istanbul with their magnificent street and city views.

reviews.text:
Great location. Nice clean well stocked apartment. Good communication with host.
Noise from upstairs apartment was a little disruptive but I understand this is an issue with a lot of properties on the Adalar. First two nights totally fine. 3rd night a group of guests arrived and it was a struggle to sleep above the noise.

The apartment is great! Super clean and very well located! The employees were quick the small issues we had with hot water and making a fire! I would definitely recommend :) If you plan on cooking a lot, maybe bring a few equipments because there’s not a lot in the flat
Ev gerçekten fiyat performans eviydi. Konumu harika her yere çok yakın. Ev de temizdi

Ev sahibi konaklamamız öncesinde verdiği talimatlarla hızlı bir şekilde oteli ve ofisi bulmamızı sağladı. Konumu merkeze çok yakın olduğu için ulaşım konusunda hiçbir sıkıntı yaşamadık. Ev hem temiz hem de ferahtı, ana ihtiyaçlarımızın tümünü bulabildik. Çok keyifli bir konaklama geçirdik, teşekkür ederiz.
It was an amazing experience. very clean and cozy apartment. Close to the souq, services, and to the ferry station yet quiet. They are very kind and very helpful.

description:
Welcome to Grisverde Suites in vibrant Ataşehir, Istanbul.
Our modern suites are ideal for business travelers, medical visitors, and tourists.

Enjoy a separate living and bedroom, a comfortable sofa bed, and a luxurious bathroom with a walk-in shower and hairdryer.

The stylish workspace and fast Wi-Fi keep you connected. Experience the comfort of home with hotel luxury.

Book your stay at Grisverde Suites today!

reviews.text:
Öncelikle çok fazla kural vardı, kendinizi bir lise öğrencisi gibi hissedebilirsiniz. Ama hem kuralla sıkıntım yok hem de bu kurallar zaten ilanda belirtilmişti. Konaklamanın olumlu be olumsuz tarafları şu şekilde:
Olumlu:
-Ev sahibi mesajlara hızlı cevap veriyor.
-Otopark sıkıntısı yok. Kaldırımda kendine ait otoparkı var.
-Ev sahibi oldukça kibar bir beyefendiydi.
Olumsuz:
-Bina oldukça kirliydi. Fotoğrafları ekledim. Klozet, lavabo, masa, çarşaflar, yastık kılıfı.. vs kirliydi. Yatakta ve yastıklarda önceki konaklayanların kılları vardı. Yastıklara tişört geçirip öyle yattık.
-Giriş yaptığımızda içeride sıvı sabun, şampuan, duş jeli ve terlik yoktu. Arayıp söyledik, biz kapıya bırakırlar diye düşünmüştük ama biz evde yokken girip bırakmışlar. Eşyaları yerleştirdikten sonra girmeleri hiç hoş değildi.
-Toplu taşımaya uzak.
-Kapılar tam anlamıyla kitlenmiyor. Ev sahibi size istediği zaman eve girebileceğini hissettiriyor.
-Günlüğü 50 dolar civarı tuttuk, bence hakkı 25 dolar.

I had a very positive experience at this hotel. The room was clean, and the staff were exceptionally friendly and helpful. The host was quick to respond to any questions, and the check-in/check-out process was seamless. It's worth noting that the area outside is noisy at times, but this is beyond the hotel's control.
The place was clean and exactly like in the photos. The host was responsive and very helpful and very well intended. I liked my stay and definitely recommend.

Nice place with plenty of parking space, hosts were very responsive and the room was exactly like in the photos. There was construction work in the opposite building so we had to have curtains drawn at all times, other than that it was a pleasant stay. Highly
Recommend

Sınav için birkaç gün konakladım, marmara üniversitesine ve yeditepeye yakındı. Bulunduğu muhitte bir yan sokakta gayet güzel mekanlar bulunmakta. Ulaşımı rahattı. Bir kadın olarak tek başıma geldiğimde konaklamaktan çekinmedim. Söylenildiği gibi aileye çok uygun. Güvenlik konusunda gayet iyi hizmet veriyorlar. Ev temiz ve görseldekiyle aynıydı. Tekrar geldiğimde tercih edeceğimden eminim. Hiçbir sorun göremedim.

description:
Our house is across the Yusufpaşa metro stop. Buses leave right next to it. Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Grand bazaar are within a 15-minute walk. The house is on the 5th floor. There is an elevator. The house capacity is 7 people. On the back street of the house, there is Marmaray, which goes from the submarine to the Asian side, within 5 minutes' walking distance.
Free wifi. There is elevator. There are AC in 4 rooms

reviews.text:
We stayed for 2 weeks at this place. Sinan is a great host and is always available for help. His kind dad greeted us and handed us the keys. Sinan’s Dad speaks Turkish & Arabic which we didn’t know, but Sinan was available on the phone to answer questions in English during check-in.
The place is clean and has everything a comfortable stay requires. We were 7 people, able to sleep easily in the 3 bedrooms (one of us on the couch, but it’s comfortable!). It’s mostly like how it’s described.
The location is great, close to stores, restaurants, and most importantly, public transportation to everywhere in walking distance (Tram, Metro, Dolmuş, busses). Get an Istanbul Card and any Istanbul attraction is reachable from this place conveniently.
An small issue was the construction noise, but during the day only. The windows are double-pane anyway to keep the place quiet. Also the elevator is very small, but it’s no big deal and works fine!
Overall l, we’d definitely recommend this place!

My stay at Sinan's place was wonderful. The apartment is fantastic - it's very clean, well-equipped, and perfectly located for exploring Istanbul. The metro and buses are close by, and there are plenty of shops and cafes in the area. Sinan is an amazing host who went above and beyond to make our stay comfortable. His sister Kubra did our check-in and was incredibly friendly and welcoming. The apartment itself is spacious and comfortable, with a lovely balcony for breakfast and a cozy sitting room with a big table. The TV and fast WiFi were great features. There were a few minor issues, such as the small elevator and noisy door, but they didn't detract from our overall experience. I highly recommend Sinan's place to anyone visiting Istanbul. Thanks for a great stay!

Lovely apartment- clean and even better than the photos. Met both Sinan and his father at check-in, both are very kind hosts and kept in communication when we needed during stay. Had enough space and everything we needed for 5 adults for a week. Location is perfect- bus and tram 2 minutes walk from the apartment and plenty of choice of shops and restaurants in the local area. Lovely view of Istanbul from living room window is added bonus! There is a small lift to the apartment on 5th floor but if you had a wheelchair like us please note, there is a set of about 6 steps inside the building before you can access the lift. Thank you for a great stay!

My wife and kids had a family reunion in Turkey. They were 4 adults and 4 kids all together. They had an excellent experience staying at Sinan’s property! The host was incredibly welcoming, responsive, and went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect. Communication was smooth and prompt, and all the questions were answered quickly. The space was clean, enough for this big family, comfortable, and exactly as described. Kitchen was fully equipped and it helped to feel like home. They truly appreciated the thoughtful touches and attention to detail. Grocery stores were 3 mins walk, doner Sadik with amazing lamb doners was next door.

We stayed 9 nights in Sinan's place and felt at home from the moment we walked in. Sinan's dad welcomed us, guided us around the flat and everything was as described.
The flat had everything you needed to feel at home from Wi-Fi, kitchen with all equipment needed to cook and serve food with dishwasher included, air conditioning in every room and a washing machine. There was a small lift that was perfect for my kids and parents.
Flat was 2 minutes away from the T1 tramline and bus stop that would take you to all the tourist destinations. Lots of shops and restaurants next to the apartment. Amazing views of Istanbul in the morning and night from the living room.
I didn't get to meet Sinan but whenever I needed anything, he was always available. I would highly recommend Sinan and his apartment.
Sinan had also arranged a taxi for us for a fee that gave us peace of mind when arriving and leaving.
We would love to come back again.
Thank you for hosting us.

description: My flat is just next to the Galata Tower which is one of the most famous historical landmarks of Istanbul. It is in the intersection of local and other touristic areas! 1 minutes walk (galata bridge, beyoglu, istiklal street, spice market etc). also 4 minutes away from metro. There are many boutique cafes around. A professional cleaning is made before each booking.The flat comes with all the modern amenities like Wi-Fi, cable TV, smart TV, comfortable bedding and much more Well-equipped kitchen.

reviews.text:
The apartment and location is nice, good for couple of days. It’s in the very center, 3 min walk from bridge and 10 min walk from main tourist places, which is nice. It has coffee machine, towels and everything to make you comfortable. Although the flat definitely need some renovations, the bed covers we’re old and covered with spools, walls had paint cracks, shower a bit of mold, floor dusty.
We arrived late at night and had a bit problems, because we weren’t prepared for walking up stairs with 4 luggages without elevator, but maybe we should have verified that before. Thanks to Cinar and his brother we had no problems moving out and carrying our stuff down the stairs , he was very helpful and on time to our taxi.
Recommend staying here!

The location is absolutely fantastic—it's a nice spot to move around and explore the area. The host was super friendly and welcoming, and the place itself was clean. However, I do feel it's quite expensive for what you get; there are hotels in the area for the same price or even less.
Be aware that the stairs can be tricky if you're traveling with heavy luggage. Also, there's bar music audible from the street until around midnight. It's not deafening, but light sleepers will definitely notice it.
Overall: good for the location and hospitality, but consider the noise and value before booking.

Great location, it's close to everything but still peaceful at night. Literally next to the cinematic stairs and 2min walk to multiple restaurants, bars and other nice places. The accomodation is clean and has 2 ac units.
Isa, the host, is very warm and welcoming. He gave us good tips and made our trip unforgettable. While visiting it's worth checking his store (Briva) for high quality shirts (linen, cotton etc) for fair prices. The store is very close to the accomodation, it was nice that Isa was in the neighbourhood.
Thank you Isa! I hope we'll meet again some day

The location is unbeatable. 5 min (uphill) walk to Galata tower which offers a plethora of shops, cafes, and restaurants. Also 7 minute walk to Karakoy (downhill, much easier) where the night life is great and has endless options for things to do.
Also very close to different modes of commuting like the Marmaray (subway), Tram, Buses, and Ferries are all accessible through walking.
We would Bus to Taksim square (one 6 minute bus ride) and walk down istiklal street. by the time you walked the entire street youre like 5 minutes from home.
The place itself is very clean and the AC is A+. However theres a bit of limit on storage space so if you're traveling with 2 full size luggage bags, you probably wont be able to pack everything away neatly.
Çınar was by far the most responsive host i've come across. Responded to every message literally within 2-3 minutes maximum. Also helped us bring up our luggage bags and bring them down the building staircase which was very helpful.

Great value for the area. Clean comfortable apartment with floor to ceiling windows. Great location to explore Galata, Karakoy, and easy 5 min metro ride to Hag Sophia and Blue Mosque. Great restaurants and Bars, and fish restaurants at the bottom of the hill. Friendly and accommodating host.

description:
This studio apartment is located at the heart of city’s coolest neighbourhood ''Moda'' walking distance to Kalamış Coast, shops, restaurants, famous bars, markets and all transportation. Just a 5 minutes walk to the famous “Boğa Heykeli”.

- Designed with taste, this apartment will be ideal for anyone who is seeking comfort, a “home like” atmosphere, accessibility to major tourist attractions.

-Self check-in is also available using the password
-The sofa is prepared for the third person.

reviews.text: This studio unfortunately does not look like on the pictures. It is quite old, very ugly, smells bad. The bathroom is not clean either, for example the corners of the shower cabin are full of mold and I had problems with the hot water for 2 days. Maybe I was only unlucky, and I just got a bad studio, but it was an uncomfortable stay. I know if we book an Airbnb for 30 EU/day we can’t get perfect or a luxurious place, but I think hot water and cleanliness should be basic. For this price you can find a better place in Istanbul. The good thing with this Airbnb is the location, it is close to Kadiköy center and you can reach the metrobus station easily on foot. Moreover, the hosts were friendly and helpful to me, after 2 days they fixed the hot water issue. All in all, unfortunately I have to say that I can’t really recommend this place to anyone.

Just like on the pictures, very good location and good price !
It would've been better if the previous guests didn't smoke inside because the smell was too strong to be able to sleep comfortably. Also, the hot water wasn't working some times.
Gamze is really responsible and available, thank you.
I will come back again

The apartment is exactly as described. As others have mentioned the bed is harder than we are used to but we had no trouble sleeping. For us one of the major attractions is the lift as my partner has difficulty walking down stairs. The staff on site are lovely and very helpful. We were provided with clear instructions on how to check in, making it an easy process. We couldn’t hear any outside noise and only a little from inside the building.
The only issue we had was with Google maps which gave us misdirection. In this case Apple Maps was far more accurate.
It’s a short walk from the metro, Söğütlüçeşme station and bus service.
There are loads of restaurants and food shops nearby. It’s a short walk to the centre of Kadikoy and the ferry across the Bosphorus, yet it away from the crowds.
Overall we enjoyed staying here.

We had a nice stay. For what you pay, you get a clean, safe stay with very good hosts and onsite staff support. We loved the area, as it puts you close to lots of shops, restaurants, and transit options. We really appreciated how helpful the hosts were -- even giving us a drying rack to use for our laundry. There is very little street noise (even during soccer games at the stadium nearby), but you can sometimes hear other guests in the hostel building. The Wi-Fi and AC both work well, and the kitchen had a good fridge.
When we first arrived, there was some mold in the shower. After we alerted the hosts, they were very helpful in quickly resolving the issue, which we appreciated. The apartment is non-smoking, which was great. If you are very sensitive to smells, you may still be able to smell some smoke scent.

Very nice place, clean, heated, comfortable, and very well located in the Anatolian (Asian) part of the city
The host was available on the minute for every detail we asked for - very flexible and understanding as well
Thank very much!

description:
Just few steps away from Findikli Tram Station which goes to OLD CITY, 600 meters to Kabatas port and 800 meters from TAKSIM square.
Perfectly comfortable and classy as all eRa Houses.

-Elevator
-High Speed Internet VDSL
-Smart Tv with Wifi
-A/C
-Dishwasher
-Fridge
-Heaters
-Microwave
-Full equipment kitchen
-Washing machine
-Dryer (L.R.)
-Work Table/Chair(opt)

This building just for airbnb and it has 6 apartments.

reviews.text:
At first glance, the apartment appeared perfect in the photos. However, when we arrived, it was not as good as it looked in the pictures. We later found another place that was both cheaper and significantly better.
This apartment still had several positive aspects: the internet connection was reliable, the bathroom was clean, and the location was excellent. One day during our stay, there was a water outage in the area, and unfortunately, the safe box was not functional. The host’s response time was exceptional. The lighting, contrary to some reviews, was not as bad as others had mentioned.
On the downside, the apartment could benefit from some minor renovations.

Our stay at eRa Suite4 TAKSIM was very pleasant. The apartment's location is a significant advantage, being conveniently close to the Findikli Tram station. This offered good connections to the Old City and Kabatas port, and Taksim Square was within reasonable walking distance.
The suite was clean, comfortable, and presented in a modern style, consistent with the "classy" description. It was well-equipped with necessary amenities such as a functional kitchen, reliable WiFi, and a dedicated workspace. The self check-in process was straightforward and efficient.
The host, Re, is a Superhost, and the apartment appeared well-managed. The presence of an elevator in the building was appreciated, as were the security features like exterior cameras and a carbon monoxide alarm.
Overall, eRa Suite4 served as a good base for exploring Istanbul. We found it to be a comfortable and practical choice, and would recommend it to others seeking a well-situated accommodation in the city.

This is a very nice place to stay - cozy, clean, secure and comfortable. The location is central and within walking distance to public transportation, grocery stores, pastry shops, Starbucks, etc. The room is well-equipped with everything a traveler may need for short and/or long trips, including a patio and bi-weekly cleaning service. There is also an elevator in the building and a laundry room in the basement, which is a huge plus. Both Ra and Okan have been amazing hosts - very responsive and accommodating. They helped me with arranging airport transfer as I arrived late at night and let me check in earlier so that I didn't have to wait at the airport. It is a great place - I definitely recommend it!

I recently had the pleasure of staying at this Airbnb and I have nothing but good things to say! The apartment was spotlessly clean and had everything we needed in the bathroom and kitchen. The location was perfect - just a short walk from both the bus station and the tram way station, and also very close to the sea. We appreciated how convenient it was to get around and explore the area. The host was also incredibly friendly and helpful, making our stay even more enjoyable. I highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a comfortable and well-equipped place to stay in the area!

Our stay was wonderful. The place is nice, clean, and well-organized, with a convenient location close to everything. The host was very responsive, and everything was exactly as described. We highly recommend this place to other guests and look forward to returning in the future.

description:
Stone walls, a nostalgic atmosphere and a charming window overlooking the Galata Tower.

It is both comfortable and romantic.

Our apartment is completely exclusive to you with fast Wi-Fi, Smart TV, a comfortable bed, a high-performance air conditioning, a kitchenette.

A unique experience for guests who want to experience the historical Istanbul with their spirit.

reviews.text:
My family stay in Istanbul has been excellent. I'll better write down the bullet points as Mehmut is an excellent host, helpful, trouble-shooter, always available & very accommodating
Plus Points :
Wow location - Galata Tower is a neighbour
Beautiful & clean new apartment
Very secure & easy access for residents
Full apartment is heated
Hot water round the clock with good pressure
Basic amenities are all stocked up
New & clean sheets/duvets
Basic kitchen needs for survival are all there
Clean & hygienic washroom
Fast Wifi internet
Grocery shop & famous eateries downstairs
Negative Points :
No lift (we stayed on 3rd floor), but its not there in any of the B&Bs with such prime location. Anyway, it's not much of a negative as you only have to climb your luggage once.
I must say that it definitely was home away from home. I would strongly recommend would-be travellers to come stay here only.

positives:
- Good condition
- Was liked photos
- Senem was responsive and allowed one
extra hour of later check out
- Centrally located
- Has very over the Galata tower
- Bedroom is at the back of the apartment so you couldn't hear street noise which was a lot especially on Saturday night.
- Convenience store right opposite the main entrance.
Negatives:
- Third floor with no lift. No help was provided to carry suitcases up or down.
- Apartment's main door is the same sliding door as the inner ones, so super easy for someone to break into. I didn't feel unsafe but we found building's main door many times not properly closed.
-The view of the Galata tower is from a narrow space with a cushion in the living, so if you imagine sitting on the sofa and enjoy it's not the case.
-Bedroom cannot be 100% in the dark during morning/daytime so people who need it to sleep must know that.
-When asked for airport transfer advice from host the serviced offered was very overpriced.

There were a few things in this property we rented for the location that were not shown or mentioned, and I’d like to point them out. First, the house is much smaller than it appears, especially the bedroom — the bed is small, and there’s barely any space to move around. Second, the kitchen is more symbolic than functional. Third, the air conditioner is located in the bedroom, not in the living area. Considering that the living room gets a lot of sun, it can get quite hot in the summer. The host is responsive and attentive. Overall, it's a property that matches the price, but keep the above points in mind when making your decision.
Thanks,
Mehmet.

Very cozy place!
Very clean, great location, close to SOK grocery store and a local store that is open late right in front of the front door. It takes 5 minutes to the subway, 25 minutes to Taksim Square. Galata is a 1 minute walk.
About every room:
There is a small kitchen. It is right in the hallway, but it is possible to cook, which is a big plus.
The bedroom is in a separate room, very comfortable mattress and pillows. The linens smell nice and the towels are dry (we were afraid they would be wet because of the reviews, but everything was fine: dry and clean).
Heating is good, you can turn it up if it's not enough.
The living room is cozy, comfortable sofa, beautiful decorative elements, you can see the Galata Tower from the window.
Internet works well, watched movies on Netflix in good quality.
We were helped to check in and deal with a bunch of our questions by Cihan, thank him very much for that - very attentive, understanding young man. Answered quickly, within a couple of hours, very polite.
Highly recommend!

The apartment is exactly the same as the photos in the ad. Heating and hot water are very good. The bed is very comfortable. The internet is strong. The apartment is hygienic and clean. The location is great. You can walk everywhere. Walking on the streets is enjoyable and safe. You can find dozens of shops, cafes and restaurants in the surrounding area. The view of the place is truly fascinating. We will definitely come again.

description: Our facility, located in Beşiktaş Akaretler, one of the most beautiful and central locations in Istanbul, offers its guests 24-hour reception and high security services. The building is new and built in accordance with earthquake regulations. Our facility offers an elevator, free Wi-Fi and daily cleaning service. Full-capacity kitchens and kitchen utensils, and ironing facilities are offered free of charge in all our apartments. We do not have a parking lot for the building.

reviews.text:
I was willing to pay a bit more for a self-contained apartment that was reasonably central, but it did not deliver on promises.
I’ll start with the pieces that were good or accurate. The bed was reasonably comfortable and bed linens were provided, as were towels. The place was spacious and had a small balcony. Despite being close to a busy street, it was quiet. Bottled water and a small Nespresso machine were provided. A 24/7 reception is nice.
But what was missing was far too much given the outrageous price that they’re charging. What they claim to be an outfitted kitchen was not in the least. There was a two-burner cooktop and a bar fridge, but no plates or pots or pans. There was no dish soap or dish towels.
The place has been neglected. The kitchen floor had some kind of accident where about 3 foot in diameter is soggy, the edges sharp as not aligned. A metal bar to the bathroom rises an inch from the floor, easy to trip. All furniture looks stained. It’s disappointing!

I had an amazing stay here! The apartment was spotless — everything was incredibly clean and well-kept. The view of the Bosphorus is absolutely breathtaking, even better than the photos. You can really feel the charm of Istanbul from this place. The location in Beşiktaş is perfect — central, safe, and full of life. I would definitely come back again. Highly recommend!

I had a fantastic experience at this hotel in Beşiktaş. The rooms were spotlessly clean, the host was responsive, and the view from the balcony was absolutely beautiful. Highly recommend for a comfortable and scenic stay in the city!
Perfect place for a short stay . comfortable, clean and staff are very helpful.
Kemal bey ile iletişim çok kolay ve hızlı oldu. Konakladığımız evin temizliği ve koşulları iyiydi. Ayrıca ev sahibi ev girişten çıkana kadar çok yardımcı oldu

description:
Wireless internet. Located in the heart of Istanbul. Right next to art galleries, museum, theater, concert halls and movie theaters located at Beyoğlu, the heart of Istanbul, awaits to welcome its new residents. Walking distance to places such as Nişantaşı, Taksim and Cihangir.

Have elevator and garage. New and high quality furniture. Good for couples. Has a city view, please check photos for details.

reviews.text:
The apartment is very comfortable and modern and The Kitchen is well equipped. The amenities of the building are great!
The host was super hospitable, very responsive and attentive.
The location is the only down side. There’s not much around. We took cabs to our favorite Istanbul spots, and that wasn’t a problem.
We would definitely recommend this property!

Thank you for this great apartments. But it would be better, if we had a cleaning service. Maybe we didn’t understand how to order that. A little far away from Taksim square, for about 25 min to walk. Design of this apartments looks really nice.

Worst host worst room. Host is not at all cooperative. Very bad behaviour I will not suggest anyone to go there it’s the worst experience of my life. Please please don’t go for this. It’s my request to everyone. They talk very badly. While you are staying they can come anytime to tell you to check out for no reason. Worst experience ever. And airbnb is not at all supportive. They take your money and vanish

The apartment was spacious and provided everything we needed for a 1 week stay. The location was good, could reach the Metro with a short walk. I would definitely recommend picking this for a short stay in Istanbul and whenever I visit next time will look at booking this once again.
Thank you very much for my stay. Very friendly host and nice apartment. 🙏🏻❤️

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text: The place is excellent, it has everything you need for a comfortable family stay. Clean, spacious apartment in a nice gated complex with covered parking lot, next to a metro station so you can easily get anywhere you need. The host is great and answers to all your needs. I will visit again!

The place once must have been very nice apartment. However now it seems it hasn't been cleaned and maintained properly for looong time. Dust everywheere, rubbish left after last guests, windows had a layer of dirt that thick that it was dark in the rooms. In bedrooms, there were no covers for the blankets. The check in was very stresful- we were supposed to be let in by security but nobody spoke a single word in english and did not want to let us in. On the plus side the building has a gym, good enough to make a basic training. Swimming pool is there however, again not well maintained (celling paint falling off to the pool...)but it is not the fault of the host. All in all it was super cheap so can't complain too much, but please put some more effort in making sure that the place is clean as it doesn't cost much.

Lovely apartment in safe security complex. Nearby public transport and clean and comfortable. Host Ahmed is very responsive and will reply immediately. We had a good stay and will come back. Beautiful place for family holidays.

The apartment was clean and tidy , it's location is very good, especially since it is in a residential complex surrounded by security , where you feel safe, in addition to the presence of a gym that is open 24 hours a day, so you can exercise at any time. The apartment is also close to public transportation, as it is close to Davutpaşa metro station (about 10 mins walking) .
our host Yusuf is easy to reach and he let us check out late .
There are some small notes, such as the bathroom needs points to hang clothes and towels and to fix the shower door. However, in general, the apartment is excellent.

Konum olarak bizim için oldukça iyiydi. Evin ulaşımı çok kolaydı metro, tramvay ve otogara çok yakındı. Giriş çıkışlar da herhangi bir sıkıntı yaşamadık. description:
A fully equipped, luxurious suite that will meet all of our guests’ expectations. The suite is located in a brand-new condominium near mall of Istanbul.
Our guests will enjoy an elegant stay with a hotel-like atmosphere without sacrificing convenience or space.
The apartment features 5-star amenities including: AC, WIFI, a dishwasher, an electric kettle, a microwave, a coffee corner, a water dispenser, a Smart TV, and ceiling-high windows.

reviews.text: I spent a lot of time here and I really liked it. It's not very close to the center (not close to Sisli or Fatih), however there are nearby amenities like the Istanbul Mall (5 minutes by car), Starbucks (7 minutes by foot), the 212 Mall (12 minutes by foot), and the File Supermarket (15 minutes by foot). The apartment has a dishwasher, washer, dryer, hair dryer, tea kettle, even a vacuum cleaner, an iron, a TV with Netflix, air conditioning, and heat. It is also quite clean. There were no issues at all, and the host is a wonderful, kind, and incredibly helpful person. I'm grateful!
I really enjoyed a lot at this apartment, everything was so great, the people were helpful and it was very clean and also in a good location near to the Mall of Istanbul.

Welcoming, helpful hosts and lovely vibes. The apartment has all things needed for a carefree stay and is very comfortable and safe. Wonderful stay, the check-in and check-out experience was superb and flexible. We were truly grateful, would recommend.
Apartment is awesome, surely recommended! Communication with host is great, checkin was very comfortable

reviews.text: Great place to stay, everything was as described and the host was very helpful and friendly! Will stay there again for sure.

description: Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this quiet, centrally located place.

reviews.text:
I was very satisfied with my stay. The bathroom was clean and comfortable, and the kitchen was very well-equipped; I made many different meals and it never felt limiting. The landlords are wonderful people who helped me a lot. And I miss Hermes :(
The location is peaceful and more conservative, and the people who work in the vicinity rarely speak English. There is a bus station near the apartment that can take you to Kadiköy or Üsküdar, and there are two metro stations about 15 and 20 minutes' walk away, respectively.

I stayed at Hilal's place for 1 month and I really enjoyed my stay. The apartment is cozy and comfortable, it has everything that you need and is cleaned regularly. I had to work remotely, so the room was good also. The apartment is in a quiet and safe location, there is transportation and you can go to anywhere from there. Nearby, there are supermarkets, cafés and anything you may need.
Hilal is very nice person, she is welcoming and kind and it was nice to be around her. If you need anything she will help you for sure. I recommend this place and I would book it again if I come back.
Fabulous host and super accommodating. The only thing I would change is the slow internet as I work from home sometimes and at times the kitchen was crowded at dinner time with everyone cooking.

The appartment is good.

Hilal is very helpful and friendly. Location is quiet and comfy. And cats are adorable!

description: Welcome to our brand new, modern, ground level, reverse duplex in the heart of the city! Close to all tourist attractions and easily accessible to cafes, restaurants and public transportation! This home has a fully equipped kitchen with a cozy dining area. Comes with 1.5 bathrooms and a spacious bedroom downstairs and a pull out couch that turns into a couch bed. Suitable for 4 guests this open space modern home is the perfect stay for guests looking to explore the beautiful city of Istanbul!

reviews.text:
We had an absolute amazing time at Palaska 29. I will leave a long review because it was an absolute pleasure to stay there, the hosts were ever so helpful and responsive, and someone can benefit from all the details, because when we were going through various airbnb options, reviews helped us a lot.
The apartment is in pristine condition, its literally new, and very tastefully decorated, and since lounge and bedroom are separated by stairs so quite spacious as well. The room especially is quite big. Its wonderfully located in a clean and quiet street, and within its 20-150 meter radius in the same/across/parallel streets there are so many restaurants, dessert places, grocery stores, fruit shops, they were so many that we couldn’t explore all.
Amenities
Saying the apartment is wonderfully stocked is an understatement, from all kitchen accessories stove, dishwasher, vacuum cleaner along with other stuff (plates, pots, pans and everything imagineable, kettle, juice and even a standwich maker) were there. We needed it for the basic stuff, but kitchen area was such a delight, anything u need, they had it. Other than that, iron, iron stand, washing machine, drier and other accessories were available too. There is a washroom downstairs, and a powder room upstairs, again its new so needless to comment on hygiene as it was as if i were the first guest there. Yeap, and readily available Hot water in taps too. Also, they are plenty of wardrobes, and storage space, plentyyy. In the lounge, there is ikea’s Friheten sofa come bed, which turns into a very comfortable sofa come bed (queen size). The actual bed downstairs was very comfortable as well. Though the apartment is sufficiently lit, the bedroom is in basement and can get a bit humid, but aircon is there (upstairs and downstairs both), which u can turn to cool/heat mode to let the air flow a bit if it gets humid or open the window upstairs (it was again fine for us, since a quiet room provided a perfect place for kids to sleep peacefully after a long day outside).
Upon request, they provided a high chair, cot and a microwave which were crucial for our existence, as we went with a super hyper toddler. (Extra information, but the pillow case and blanket cover of toddler cot were such a cute pattern, my toddler immediately chose the cot to snuggle into, and did not complain to hop into our bed)
One con to consider: Cihangir and most of Beyoglu have sharp slopes and ups and downs. We were with kids, so doing that with strollers was a bit of a challenge, since our fitness levels aren’t so great too. Its close to main locations like Istiklal street (10 mins walk), and Tophane Tram Station (6-8 mins walk), (again sharp slopes r there, but we got used to it) if you are new to istanbul its a must to be close to tram/metro station, (taxi’s were not a great option for us).
All in all i give a 5 star ⭐️ for the price we paid, it was like living in a premium hotel with all the amenities and more. The way the apartment is built and furnished, it was as if someone really put their heart in it. Super super clean. It was quite comfortable for us to stay there. Oh and yes, there was netflix logged into the TV as well, which was a plus!!

It’s a great balance for those who want walkable distance from Galata and Taksim but also sleep peacefully without loud noise outside.
The place is looking clean and nice as in pictures. Seamless check-in and kind host made things easy.
The wifi was at good speed.
Heating and AC works well.
The best stay in Istanbul so far!

Clean and quiet. I like the design and the location. Very responsive host.
No phone service at the bed room downstairs and wifi is good but the internet is slow most of the time
