We had a nice stay overall. The location was excellent - very close to the center, with many cafés, bars, and restaurants nearby, while still being calm and quiet. The apartment was cozy and comfortable, and having two bathrooms was very convenient.
The hosts were very communicative, responded quickly, and were very helpful. They also kindly allowed us to check in earlier than the scheduled time when we arrived, which we really appreciated.
The main issue during our stay was the AC. Since Istanbul was very hot, the AC was not cooling the apartment enough, making it difficult to stay inside during the day. The bedroom was a bit better, but improving the AC would make a big difference.
I also noticed that the blanket underneath the cover had some spots/stains, so paying more attention to bedding cleanliness would improve the experience for future guests.
Overall, we enjoyed the apartment and the location, and with these improvements, it would be a great stay.

description: Enjoy your next stay in Istanbul in this new completely refurbished modern flat in the heart of the city. The flat comes with all amenities as well as tastefully chosen interior furniture and comfy bedding.

reviews.text:
Cristina’s place is very cozy and homely, and we had a wonderful 4-night stay as a family of four. The apartment is clean, functional, and equipped with air conditioning in both bedrooms and the living room. The AC works very well, and the beds are extremely comfortable, so we slept soundly throughout our stay. The kitchen has all the essentials.
The neighborhood is quiet, and although the streets are narrow, parking is free if you’re arriving by car. There are plenty of grocery stores and restaurants within walking distance.
Cristina is a warm, friendly, and responsive host. Overall, this apartment was a great start to our holiday in Turkey.
Note: The living room is a little smaller than it appears in the photos, but it was still manageable. Also, one bedroom opens onto a balcony; if the neighbor opens their balcony door early in the morning, it can be a bit noisy, even with the door closed.

I rented this flat in Sep 2023 for a family of 4. The flat was better than described in pictures, very clean, all facilities worked well, spotless and its very important that it is located on first floor. With heavy luggages you don’t need to climb the stairs👍🏽. Less than 10 min walk to Taksim square. 5 min walk to supermarket, 1 min walk to small shops.
Cristina is very friendly and responds shortly after each message. And she also very helpful and flexible.
I do recommend this flat as it is worth it.

We had a wonderful stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and in a great location. Everything was as described, and the host was very kind and helpful. We really enjoyed our time here and would happily stay again. Highly recommended!

If I could give 10 star I would for Cristina Apartment, The real you looked more Beautiful Tidy clean than on pictures, New Furnitures, simply comfortable Beautiful design, Great Location, Good Communication with Cristina 💕 All you need is available at apartment I feel like at my own home. I WOULD love to go back and suggested to my friends to stay and For Me NO MORE HOTEL at Istanbul😍, and More perfect If check out time is 12 pm ☺️💕

We had a great stay! The apartment was clean and comfortable. The kitchen had everything we needed, even dishwasher tabs. Both the sofa and beds were very comfortable. We had a technical issue during our stay, but Cristina reacted quickly and had everything solved within two hours. The location is great, within walking distance to Taksim. We’ll definitely come back if we’re in Istanbul again!

description: In this house, which is 5 minutes' walk from Istiklal Street, you can be a part of the outside world at any time you want and experience peace and comfort at the same time in a historical building. The living room and other rooms of the house, whose kitchen and bathroom are fully furnished. We have two bedrooms, each suitable for a couple. One of the bedrooms has a sofa that can be converted into a double bed. In addition, the living room sofa can comfortably accommodate one person.

reviews.text: We went expecting to meet a host, we came away with a lifelong friend. The apartment is a short walk from Istiklal Street and Taksim Square, from where it's easy to get around the city. The apartment is clean, compact and tastefully done up. We were happy to be surrounded by books. The apartment is up one flight of stairs. It is fully furnished and has all the amenities for a fantastic stay. The bed is comfortable, with pillows and crisp clean sheets. The wi-fi is great too. Kenan is easy to communicate with and helped us with great recommendations for local food places. Highly recommended, we would love to come back.

Kenan is a great host, responsive and thoughtful . His place is beautiful and really spacious, it has everything you would need to feel at home. Bed is really comfortable and everything was clean . Bus station is a few minutes by foot and metro station is about 15minutes from apartment. But... the best thing about this place and Istanbul in general are the cats 🐈🐈‍⬛🐈🐈‍⬛ .There is many of them outside the building. If you see them, please pet them and give them wet food (they have it in every store and it's cheap). Kind regards from Nina and Ratko

Kenan's place exceeded our expectations. It was really spacious (separate kitchen, one full bedroom, a large bathroom with shower) and tastefully decorated. The apartment is in a walking distance to Istikal boulevard(believe me, you would be going to there one way or another if you are staying in Beyoglu area). The place is filled with books, and though they were in Turkish and not accessible to us, we immediately felt a sense of kinship with the host. You could not ask for a better host than Kenan. He responds in a matter of not minutes but seconds, so you are never left stranded. He went above and beyond of his call of duty as a host and even helped us out in some situations even though they had nothing to do with Airbnb. I can't recommend Kenan's apartment and Kenan as a host enough. He made our Istanbul experience a lot more special.

Kenan is super friendly, very polite, and a very good host. The apartment is very comfortable, very well arranged and clean. Better than in the photos. The location is unbeatable, 15 minutes walk from the center, in a very typical neighborhood with friendly people. Here you can get to know the real Istanbul. All fantastic, I recommend it

That was probably one of the best Airbnb experiences I've had so far. The apartment is extremely cozy and atmospheric, probably, that's due to enormous amount of books and small details, like Salvador Dali's reproductions on the walls, or very comfortable armchair in the corner of a living room. It feels like home there. The host is just amazing: his English is on point, so we didn't have any communication issues at all, he responded immediately to all of our questions, and even let us stay in the apartment after check-out time, so we didn't have any problems with where to put our luggage before departure from Istanbul. The apartment has a perfect location as it's only a few minutes walk away from Istiklal, it's spacious, neat, clean and well-equipped. Overall, highly recommended, I would love to stay there once again.

description: This stylish place is close to must-see destinations.

reviews.text:
What you might think from the pictures and the value is "It looks too good to be true", but it really is as good as it looks.
The hotel is cozy, clean and has a sense of luxury. The value aspect is one of the best you can get in Istanbul. The room was cleaned almost everyday.
Ali (who is the receptionist) is very attentive, polite and knows how to please a guest. Communication was good. And the bed was comfortable. Location is 6 minutes walk from The Blue Mosque and 12 minutes from Aya Sofia Mosque.
I recommend it to anyone who is looking for value to his/her money.

Place was not clean as I thought when I saw the pictures. Internet was not working during the first 2 days. Place is near Hagia Sophia Church and the old palace and the blue mosque, but not very central location. far from the new European town or Asia side. Need to go across many small street, not feeling very comfortable.

The place matched the description. Muhammed at the reception was very kind and helpful to us.
The place is located 10min walk from the blue mosque and 25 min walk from the grand bazaar, but there are some hills. At night it was a bit noisy since there is a club around, but you can handle it unless you are sensitive to noises.
The bed was very comfortable and the room was cozy.

As we arrived at the hotel, we were told by the younger brother who seems to manage the airbnb accommodation that they had already given our room to someone else. To be fair, he was really lovely, and very apologetic and offered to help us carry our bags to his families other hotel which was about a 7 minute walk. He re-assured us that we would be getting room upgrade and his older brother would take care of us at the nearby hotel. Once we arrived, the older brother who seems to manage the hotel (The Camelot Hotel) , he did not seem to give any remorse or care. We also felt he tried to hide the fact that it was a family run business as he tried to confuse the situation that he had no idea why we were being transferred to his hotel (even though we heard him on the phone to his younger brother moments before this). We also did not get a room upgrade and in fact got something smaller. When we asked if breakfast was included he said this was only for his guests that booked through him

I really enjoyed my stay here. The location is perfect and is a very safe area. the blue mosque and Sofia mosque are a 5 min walk away. There’s plenty of really good restaurants and shops around and the grand bazaar is about a 15 min walk. The room was perfect if you need a place to stay which is simple but super stylish. the bathroom was super nice. the staff are amazing my room was cleaned everyday and the reception is open 24/7 and they’re super helpful and attentive. Everyone is super friendly, i really recommend this place if you’re looking to be in the heart of istanbul.

description: My flat has a living room, two bedrooms and a bathroom. Situated at the very center of İstanbul, an underground station and the Cevahir Shopping Center are only 8 minutes walk away. The nearest bus stop is 5 minutes walk away. Many shops, cafes, restaurants, supermarkets, pharmacies and a hospital are all within walking distance. The apartment has 120 square meter garden full of fruit trees. There is three air condition in the Living room and the bedrooms.

reviews.text: We had a great time staying at Nilüfer's place. Nilüfer is a responsive and kind hostess: she generously let us check in earlier than the stated time. The place is spacious and the photos are accurate. The location is very convenient: it is near metro and bus stations and there are a lot of grocery shops, cafes, bakeries, and restaurants nearby. However, one thing that was not mentioned in the description is that there are about 20 stairs that you need to climb down to get from the building entrance to the apartment, so keep that in mind in case you have mobility issues. Also, the cleaning products, like toilet rolls, dishwashing detergent, hand soap were insufficient for long stays.

We had a lovely stay at Nilufer's cozy and pretty place. It completely matched the pictures and description that we had seen. Nilufer was there to give us a warm welcome when we arrived and left only after making sure we had all the information we needed about the house and the neighbourhood. The house was spotlessly clean and had all the amenities we needed for a comfortable stay. There are fruit shops and groceries in close proximity and many restaurants a short walk away. The area around the house is quiet as well. Every instruction on how to access the internet, to use the washing machine or to lock and unlock the door were clearly written down. Nilufer was very accommodating with a last minute request that we had as well. So, everything added up to us having a wonderful happy comfortable stay in one of the most beautiful cities in the world.

We enjoyed our stay in this home very much. Nilüfer is an attentive and caring host. She is very responsive.
The home is very clean and modern with most amenities one needs for a comfortable stay.
The location is optimal being close to the metro station and a major bus station that connects to most parts of Istanbul, including a direct line to the Istanbul International Airport. There are plenty of grocery stores in the neighbourhood with very reasonable prices. There is also a modern mall (Cevahir Mall) at a walking distance.

Definitely recommended. The flat is very nice and clean, and the photos and the description are all accurate. The living room is actually more spacey than we imagined based on the photos, so it was a nice surprise. It is very clean so no complaints there, and everything we needed was provided. The garden is nice and is privately accessed, and the building is at a very good location with access to Stores, subway, restaurants, etc.
The owner is very nice and responsive and we felt very well taken care of all throughout.
100% will stay here again!

Thanx Nil for the wonderful stay
The location is great just 10 mins/500 meters from the metro and from cevahir mall also many hypers and pharmacies, and a lot of shops, she is very responsive and helpful.
The apartment itself is very equipped, kitchen has everything you would need for, and super clean.
Nilufer has everything instructed and clear. Also the Appartment is heated and comfy, it is in a safe area and accessible location.
Would definitely recommend it!

description: I guarantee you will have a peaceful and pleasant time staying in this apartment. You will enjoy staying in this private apartment, which has the comfort of a 5-star hotel and where every detail has been thought of. You can cook for yourself in the large and spacious kitchen, or you can taste the flavors of Turkish cuisine at the restaurant in the lobby. Its location is central, 20 minutes from the airport, 10 minutes from Kadıköy, indoor and outdoor swimming pool, playground for children, gym, hairdresser for men and women

reviews.text:
The apartment is in a modern building in a good location in Istanbul. Also has an underground garage but it needs to be worked out with the host beforehand since it requires the car to be registered to it.
The place itself is well decorated, comfortable with good quality appliances, very well cleaned and mainteined. Also you have access to the buildings facilities (pool,gym etc) for which unfortunately we didnt have enough time to go and check out. You also have access to multiple balconies on different floors for amazing views of Istanbul and some cool pics, and a garden + pool.
Really satisfied with our stand and our host who was very communicative and very friendly. Will look him up next time we are in Istanbul!
The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. The host was very friendly and easy to communicate with!

Ev düzenli ve güzeldi. İlanda belirtilen tüm hususları barındırıyordu. Evin konumu, site içi olması ve olanakları güzeldi. Kolay bir giriş sağladık ve eve giriş saatlerinde yardımcı oldular. Kapalı otoparka giriş mümkün olmasa da açık otoparkı rahatlıkla kullandık. İlanın açıklamalar kısmını dikkatle okumanızı öneririm. Yalnızca 3. kişi için ayrıca ücret talebinde bulunulmasına rağmen üçüncü için pike ve yastık bulunmuyordu. Bu hususu eve çok geç geldiğimiz için iletmedim fakat en başından 3 kişi kalacağı bilinmesine rağmen hazırlık yapılmamıştı. İlaveten 3 günden kısa süre konaklamalarda temizlik için ek ücret politikaları bulunsa da ev ek ücrete değecek kadar temizlenmemişti. Yanlış yönlendirme yapmak istemem ev temizdi fakat ek ücret talep edilecek bir temizlik yoktu :)

Murat Bey oldukça ilgili, nazik ve yardımsever bir ev sahibiydi. Konaklamamız boyunca iletişimi çok iyiydi ve ihtiyaç duyduğumuz her konuda hızlıca yardımcı oldu. Daire temiz, konforlu ve anlatıldığı gibiydi. Güzel bir konaklama deneyimi yaşadık. Murat Bey’e ilgisi ve misafirperverliği için teşekkür ederiz, gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederiz.

Murat's apartment is very comfortable. We loved all the amenities like the sauna, steam room, swimming pool and the relaxing cafe inside the complex. Also the Carrefour supermarket inside the complex is super convenient!
The apartment itself is spacious and clean. The bedroom can get hot as only the living room has AC. But besides that we really enjoyed our stay 👍

description: Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this centrally located quiet place. Close to the Turkish German University, Medipol and Beykoz Universities. 50 meters to the bus stop. It is within walking distance to places such as the market, the beach, and the hospital. Free parking is available. It is close to Medistate Hospital.

reviews.text: Although the house appeared quite old outside, it has beautiful interior and breathtaking view from the windows. The apartment was spacious, equipped with all the necessary amenities and had good internet connection. The host was truly kind and friendly, always available and ready to offer assistance or provide helpful advice. However, there were a few downsides to my stay. Hot water only flowed from the showerhead, while the kitchen sink and bathroom sink provided only cold water. The kitchen lacked sufficient lighting, with only one working bulb. The staircase leading up to the apartment was extremely steep and challenging, especially when carrying heavy suitcases. Although the house is located near a bus stop, the buses operated with a frequency of only once every half hour. Walking to the seaside (Beykoz) is quite inconvenient, as it required traversing a busy road. It's better to have a car or take a taxi.

Ev girişi ev sahibiyle aynı kapıdan tek kapı bu büyük bir problem, en önemlisi herhangi bir güvenlik durumu söz konusu değil mahalle arasında eski bi yapı daha sonra içeri girer girmez dik bir merdiven karşılıyor önceki halıflexi kullanım dolaysıyla sanırım merdivenler sapsarı yapıştırıcı ve kötü koku var yatak konforsuz çarşaflar eski ve tiftiklenmiş yastıklar kâğıt gibi incecik klima eski gürültülü ve soğutmuyor bu yüzden iptal ettim ve kalmadım

Ev fotoğraflarda görüldüğü gibiydi. Ev sahibi her konuda gayet hızlı yardımcı oldu. Konumu itibari ile biraz yokuş mevcut ancak çok yakınından geçen otobüs hatları vardı. Muhteşem bir boğaz manzarasına sahip. Eski bir İstanbul semtinde sakin bir mahalle ortamında konaklamak isterseniz doğru bir seçim olacaktır.

Öznur hanım’ın evinden çok memnun kaldık. Boğaz manzarası fotolardakinden bile iyi. Evde gereksiz hiçbir eşya yok ama ihtiyaç olabilecek hemen her şey mevcut. Öznur hanım çok iyi bir ev sahibi, rica ettiğimiz birkaç konu vardı, hepsinde de çok yardımcı oldu. Eve çıkış merdivenleri biraz dar, fakat yaşlı değilseniz veya bir özrünüz yoksa zorlanmazsınız. Banyoda sıcak su sıkıntısı yok, fakat musluğu sonuna kadar açınca su ılık akıyor, fakat bizim için bir sorun olmadı. Genel olarak, fiyat performans açısından çok iyi bir seçim yapacağınızı düşünüyorum burada kalarak. Biz tekrar gelebilmek için sabırsızlanıyoruz.
Öznur harika bir ev sahibi ve evin konumu duraklara ve ihtiyacınız olan her yere yakın. Deniz manzarası harika. Kesinlikle paranıza değer.

description: It has a magnificent balcony and sea view.

reviews.text:
Tugba was really responsive and helpful and that was really appreciated. The flat was great and exactly as described: very clean, private, nicely decorated, with a nice balcony and bathroom, and in a really convenient location (5 minutes from the main public transport links in Kadikoy). The entrance was slightly tricky to find, but Tugba was really helpful with this too. Completely recommend - I had a wonderful time.
It is up five floors of stairs with no lifts so may not be suitable for people with mobility issues.

decent place for a short stay for one or two people
very nice location, cool balcony
host is responsive, checkin is easy
keep in mind that you need to use stairs to access a flat, also it can be a bit cold during the night, but there is an AC which can be used as a heater
good value for money

We had an excellent stay here, the place is more spacious than it looks in the photos and we love that it was surrounded by windows (although bring an eye mask if you plan to sleep past sunrise). Very comfortable bed, nice hot shower, good wifi and super kind and responsive host.
Noise levels were pretty good for Istanbul levels - the traffic noise is unavoidable in our experience, but we weren't bothered by street life/bars etc.
Would highly recommend this place- it was lovely! (so long as you're fine with stairs, its on the 5th floor)

The apartment was great for the price — clean, had all the basic and necessary things (I would suggest adding some bigger cups for drinking tea/coffee), quick and very helpful responses from the host. You can see a sliver of the harbour from the balcony — having breakfast there in the morning was probably a highlight of the stay.
The apartment is very close to the ferry station. Underground, Marmaray and numerous bus stations are also a short walk away. You live very close to the fun parts of Moda with all the bars, but the area around the flat was quiet every night, including the weekend.
In terms of furniture, you get all the essentials + a very comfortable bed, but no storage for clothes apart from a small rail. There are some small scuffs and marks in the apartment, but its not noticeable. All in all, a great place to stay.

Tugba hanima rezervasyon oncesinde gec saat olmasina ragmen sordugum soruya aninda donus sagladi ve icimi rahatlatti. Ev konum olarak mukemmel bir merkezi konumda. Tenha bir sokakta degil ve kadikoyun kalbinde. Tek basiniza seyahat ediyorsaniz gec saatlerde eve ulasim saglayabilirsiniz. Aynı zamanda ev, bardaklar, kahve makinesi vb. her sey tertemiz, tum mobilyalar yepyeniydi. Eger benim gibi remote calisan ve internet hizina ihtiyac duyan bir is yapiyorsaniz gozunuz kapali tercih edebilirsiniz, internet hizi cok guzeldi. Sadece yatak kalin oldugu icin carsaf yanlardan duzgun takilamiyordu ve her sabah uyandigimda carsaf altimda toplanmis ve aleze temas ettigimi fark etmek beni huzursuz etti. Ama temiz olduguna suphem yoktu. Her sey icin tesekkurler.🤍

description: This family home is close to all sights and amenities. Spacious and peaceful with an elevator, you will feel at home

reviews.text: Onder was incredibly responsive and accommodating throughout our stay. The accommodation perfectly mirrored the photos, and it was situated in a fantastic location, surrounded by numerous restaurants and stores.

This place felt like home and was great for our family reunion. Three bedrooms and a large living room made the long stay pretty comfortable for us all. Onder was very helpful and very clear in communication. When we asked where we need to dispose of our garbage, he sent pictures with arrows that told us exactly how to reach there. Overall a great place to stay while in Istanbul.

Onder was a really great host. Helpful and friendly. Apartment was good. Maybe it was not enough stuff at kitchen for cooking, but Onder has brought everything we asked for. Good place near Ortakoy. A lot of good cafe's and restaurants nearby.
Onder is a wonderful host. Very responsive, helping, and flexible with late check-in. His place was comfortable and had everything we needed . Highly recommended!

I stayed six nights with my family in Onder’s place. I was so stressed since I selected the place and did the reservation for my family.
But thankfully it was a good choice. We had nice and relaxing stay. Onder was really helpful. He even helped us to book a restaurant and called the place to book for us. And he let us to stay more than check out time since our flight was late evening .
The area has a lot of traffic which it’s really important to manage the commuting time. But the neighborhood is alive and vivid.
I really appreciate the kindness of Onder during our stay.

description:
In the center of Istanbul, in 4. Levent. It is in a valuable location where you can mingle with life as soon as you step in and find a solution to all your needs.
The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place.
Every minute is peaceful with controlled entrances and exits, a private security team and a state-of-the-art safety system.
Indoor parking,
Fiber fast internet,
Metro station is a 4-minute walk away.

reviews.text:
We enjoyed our stay. Place clean and as described. Around 10 mins from metro station in a local neighborhood. Old neighborhood but new secured building . Easier to walk than drive there. Many grocery stores around.
Önder was responsive, helpful and understanding.
Thank you

Son derece memnun kaldığım bir konaklama geçirdim ev sahibimiz çok ilgiliydi giriş yaparken yardımcı olan ekip arkadaşı valizimi bile taşımama yardımcı oldu çok kibardı evin konumu çok iyiydi kapalı otoparkı olması çok iyiydi ve ev tertemizdi mutfakta ihtiyacım olan Herşey mevcuttu salon aydınlık ve ferahtı yatak odası çarşafları tertemizdi banyo hijyenikti çok memnun kaldım Herşey için ev sahibimize teşekkür ediyorum 🙏

Önder's apartment was even better than expected. It was just as described - comfortable, spotlessly clean, and equipped with all the essentials. The building is modern, secure, and in a great location, just a few minutes walk from the nearest metro station, with major malls in Levent also within easy walking distance. The neighbourhood is vibrant and lively, with plenty of restaurants, shops, and supermarkets around. It’s also a beautiful area, perfect for strolls and exploring. Despite the buzz outside, the apartment itself is peaceful and quiet. The rooftop terrace is a real highlight - an awesome spot to relax and take in the stunning panoramic views of the city.

Many shops walking distance, including 2 grocery at bottom of the building. Some steep roads in and out but also easy routes. Responsive and accommodating host. Good tv, good ac, good kitchen and bed. Thanks!

Önder was an excellent host - highly communicative and responsive throughout my stay. I stayed for 1 month, and the apartment had everything I needed. It was walkable and I was able to walk to work easily and access public transportation without any difficulty.
I truly enjoyed the entire experience, from the apartment itself and the rooftop to the neighborhood and the exceptionally welcoming and kind security guards.
I would highly recommend this Airbnb and Önder as a host to anyone seeking a comfortable and authentic stay in Istanbul. I would gladly choose Önder as a host again.

description: From this central location, you can easily access everything as a group. You can enjoy the view of the coast at Tersane Istanbul, which is 100 meters away, and enjoy activities such as shopping, eating, drinking, entertainment and concerts at Tersane Mall.

reviews.text:
I highly recommend this Airbnb—it is even better than the photos. The most important part of my stay was Esra and her mom; they are incredibly warm and welcoming, and I truly felt at home. Esra also helped me with my luggage, which I truly appreciated. I also recommend asking about their menu. I had meatballs for Christmas dinner, and they were amazing—very delicious and homemade.
The best part was how much Kadriye cared about me; she even went with me to make sure I took the correct bus to the airport. Esra’s mom felt like my own mom during my stay. The home is also very well located, close to a beautiful mall and several bus stations, which made getting around very easy

Big thank you to Esra and her Mum for a lovely few days.
If you love the old school Airbnb style of staying in someone’s home then this is for you. I felt so welcome and Esra was super helpful with anything I needed.
It was a treat to stay in a local neighbourhood of Istanbul away from the tourist crowds, but everything was still easily accessible.
Oda son derece konforlu bütün ihtiyaçlar karşılanıyor, İstanbul Avrupa yakası için merkezi konumda, fiyat performans bizi tatmin etti

Would highly recommend this place if you are a woman visiting Istanbul alone. Esra and her mum are amazing hosts. I am very honoured that I got to spend time with them and their cats. Extremely helpful and kind people.

Es war eine sehr schöne Erfahrung, bei Esra und ihrer Mutter Kadriye zu Gast zu sein! Die Unterkunft ist gemütlich und sauber, die Lage sehr angenehm: ruhig und abseits der Touristenströme, aber trotzdem durch öffentliche Verkehrsmittel (Bus oder Fähre) gut angebunden. Was aber unseren Aufenthalt so besonders schön gemacht hat, war die Gastfreundschaft von Mutter und Tochter. Esra hat uns mit vielen Tipps und Informationen geholfen, Istanbul zu entdecken und und auch die Kostproben der leckeren Küche ihrer Mutter haben wir sehr geschätzt. Für Katzenfreunde wie uns ein weiterer Pluspunkt: die süßen und sehr zutraulichen Katzen! Wir hatten eine sehr schöne Zeit und bedanken uns, dass wir uns wie zuhause fühlen durften!

description: Nice well-decorated one bedroom 65m2 apartment, all-equipped, inside a secured residence. High speed internet, Live TV application includes worldwide satellite channels, movies, and series. Free parking. Grocery store within the residence. Heating and air-conditioning available. One A/C in the living room and One Fan in the bedroom.

reviews.text: Myself and my boyfriend have stayed here a few times I am English he is Turkish living in Beylikduzu with his family so we usually use AirBnB when I am visiting. The apartments here are great value for money and always very clean and modern. Great for apartment living they come with all the basic necessities you will need. If you are a remote working like me, apartments in the building that face the green park are really quiet free from traffic noise which is rare for Istanbul and you won’t be disturbed. Amal who works for Dreamville suites is an intelligent, caring and responsive host and makes sure guests are cared for.

konaklama boyunca rahat ve evinizdeymiş gibi hissedebileceğiniz temiz ve güzel bir daire araç gereçler eksiksiz konum olarak fena sayılmaz kendi otoparkı ve güvenliği olması da en büyük artılarından tavsiye ederim
Fiyat performans açısından olumlu
Tuvalet kağıtları yoktu, klima çalışmıyordu, internete bağlanamadık ve sorunu çözemediler. Tavsiye etmiyorum.
It was good

description: Located 500 meters from Taksim Square, 900 meters from Galata Port Shopping Center, 300 meters from Kabataş Findikli Tram line, in a brand new building with floor heating, all the kitchen equipment, washing machine, dryer, refrigerator, etc. you need are available in the apartment.

reviews.text:
Location was perfect! The apartment was ideally located for walking down to Galataport (where there were with many different restaurants), or walking up to Taksim Square.
The place was exactly as described in the listing - immaculately clean, very comfortable, and stocked with the right toiletries to get me started the first few days.
The host, Esra, was AMAZING! Her instructions on getting to and into apartment were super clear and precise, and she was incredibly responsive to the messages I sent – way after than I expected.
I usually prefer to figure things out by himself rather than having to contact and bother the host, but I had to reach out as my luggage (suitcase) didn’t arrive in Istanbul for several days. Esra went above and beyond, and even contacted the airline on my behalf and would often query them for updates, which she kept me informed of.
I'd highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul and wanting a fun and central area. Such an unforgettable experience!

I had a fantastic stay at Esra’s place in Istanbul. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described.
The location is excellent, close to everything, yet in a quiet neighborhood. Esra was an attentive and responsive host, providing helpful information and being available whenever needed. Her kindness and hospitality made our stay even more enjoyable.
Highly recommend staying here for anyone visiting Istanbul!

We really enjoyed our stay, the apartment is 100% as described and worth the money, the location is good, the owner was always in touch and was very helpful with check-in and transfer, everything went great!

I'm very happy with my stay at istanbul, the location of the flat is perfect, close to everything, you have arround so many nice little shop for buy everything you need like fruits etc... like walking less then 3min... very clean area, nice neighborhood, hairdresser opposite the building, 6/7min from taksim istiklal street, the apartmentis very well furnished, very good for long stays because you have wash machine, dryer, dishwasher in it... perfect for a couple. housekeeping available, and Esra is the perfect host, very reactive and friendly. the price worth it, I forget to say that every new and super ultra clean!

Overall, we enjoyed our 8 day stay at Esra's apartment. It is well-located, a quick tram ride away from Sultanahmet and a short but steep walk away from Taksim Square. Those interested in visiting Kadiköy, Ùsküdar or the Rumeli fortress can take a the ferry from the nearby dock.
However, we found the apartment to be small & fairly basic. There were also a number of minor annoyances, including a duvet that was too small for the bed and lots of hanging space but only two coat hangers. The apartment was also very warm even though it is currently winter and quite chilly outside so we had to have the air conditioning blasting whenever we were there.
The kitchen isn't particularly well-equipped for anyone looking to self cater as it lacks basic items like a can opener, a bottle opener, a peeler, a sieve, a measuring jug & so on. There were also no tea towels or oven gloves. A coffee machine, toaster and microwave would also have been helpful.

description:
Luxury and spacious 2 bedroom apartment with 2 bathrooms and a balcony with an amazing view, located next to Dolmabahce Palace, perfect for your holiday.

Historical sights and shopping streets are easily accessible. You can reach Taksim Square and Galata Port in just 7-8 minutes.

You can go to Blue Mosque and Grand
Bazaar areas with tramway passing in front of the apartment. You can join Bosphorus tours leaving from Kabatas ferry station or you can get on the boots to visit Princess Islands

reviews.text:
Samet's place was truly the best Airbnb I've stayed at! The pictures do not do it justice. I have very high expectations when it comes to cleanliness and Samet's home was pristine. The view was UNBELIEVABLE. I didn't even want to leave the apartment because I just wanted to relax in the armchair with my coffee and look outside. But if you do choose to leave, this location is phenomenal. Right next to all public transport, a great restaurant a minute walk away, next to a grocery store and midpoint to all the great locations. Very close to Taksim but without the noise and crowd. You really cannot find a place like this in Istanbul. Will definitely stay here again if it's not fully booked!
Lastly, Samet is such a wonderful host. He responds within minutes, goes out of his way to accommodate you and he's very kind and respectful. He helped us take all of our luggage upstairs (there was a lot) and made us feel right at home!

We recently stayed at Samet's apartment by Kabatas port in Istanbul with my mother, wife, and 2-year-old son for 7 nights, and it was fantastic. The location is perfect, with stunning views and easy access to ferries and public transport. We walked to Dolmabahce Palace and Taksim Square easily, and there were plenty of restaurants and shops nearby. The apartment was clean, spacious, and beautifully decorated. The living area was comfortable, the kitchen well-equipped, and the bedrooms cozy with ample storage. The fast Wi-Fi and effective air conditioning were much appreciated. Samet was an exceptional host—responsive, helpful, and arranged smooth check-in/check-out and airport transfers. One note: the mosque is near & prayers are very loud, especially the 10:30 pm call, which startled our son. While we respect this cultural aspect, it's something to be aware of if traveling with young children. Despite this, we had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend this apartment. TY Samet!

I had a fantastic stay at this apartment in Istanbul! The place was exactly as described and matched the photos perfectly. It was spacious, clean, and well-maintained, making it a comfortable home base for exploring the city. The location was excellent—close to major attractions, restaurants, and public transportation, which made getting around very easy.
A special thanks to Mr. Samet, who was very helpful throughout my stay. He provided a great list of restaurant recommendations, which made my experience even better. Highly recommended! Would definitely stay here again.
If you’re traveling with elderly people, just be informed that the apartment is located on the second floor.

This place was exactly what we were hoping for. The hosts were proactively checking in on us to see if everything was alright and even helped us arrange for transfers to/from the airport. The apartment was beautifully modern with fantastic views of the beautiful Bosphorous and of the mosque. We loved the great amenities inside, especially the high quality couch and dining room table and comfortable chairs. The best was having two toilets and sinks and the water pressure was very good. The noise level in the bedrooms were excellent. We couldn't hear anything from the neighbors above/below, nor any noise in the shared stairwell. The apartment was meticulously cleaned and the kitchen was well stocked. We would highly recommend this rental, and would gladly return.

Highly recommended, the place is spacious, comfortable and centrally located with an amazing sea view.
The neighborhood is extremely safe and walkable even at midnight, lots of excellent bars and restaurants to choose from.
Great location, few minutes walk to main public transportation (tram, Bus and Ferry).
Street parking is available for few bucks per day.
As for the host, Samet, he’s truly one of the best, fast responses and always ready to help, can’t thank him enough.

description: The whole group will be comfortable in this spacious and unique space.

reviews.text:
Arash is very polite, reactive, helpful hote!
The apartment is large, located in the center. Many restaurants, shops, cafes. Absolute peace and quiet, elevator, two kitchens, very comfortable! Excellent communication with the hote, very friendly. Thank you so much 🙏🏻☺️🙏🏻

I rented an apartment from Mr. Arash for a family vacation, and it was an excellent experience. The apartment was brand new, with everything in it being new and extremely comfortable, just as described. The location was very convenient, being very close to a metro station and having a bus stop right at the building's main entrance. Mr. Arash was a kind and respectful host who responded quickly to my messages and was always ready to help or answer any questions I had.

The apartment is very centrally located. Taksim square, bosphorus river side, nisantasi street are all walkable distance. Bus 35C comes every ten minutes just below the apartment, which connects via public transport to the rest of the city.
The apartment itself has 3 bed rooms and 2 toilets so that’s a huge plus too, if you go with family!!!!
But hygiene is an issue. We stayed for 4 nights 5 days. Not once were the towels changed or was the garbage cleared. No instructions were left as to what to do with the garbage. Fortunately there were two kitchens. We just kept collecting all garbage in the unused kitchen.
One AC wasn’t working, one window blind broke and fell. I messaged Arash. He didn’t respond. Then when he changed the main building access key and sent someone to give it to me, I showed him the AC, garbage and the broken blind. He just bought and gave me extra batteries and did nothing else.
So hygiene was a huge concern!!
Basic cutlery, water glasses were also not provided.

Arash is responsive, very respectful and also very flexible.
Beautiful, big apartment and perfect for 7 people! location and cleanliness of the place was very good.
Overall we really enjoyed our stay at this Airbnb, we felt as if at our home!
Highly Recommended.

First of all, Arash's behavior is commendable, very friendly and caring. The house is very clean with excellent accessibility and very safe, with a very beautiful view. All the bedding and towels were clean, and I really enjoyed my stay. Surely, if I come to Turkey again, I will come here again. Thanks to Arash and his team.

description:
ENG

Our spacious, peaceful family house located in one of the most decent and central neighborhoods of Büyükada.

reviews.text: Mustafa Can Bey son derece ilgili ve sıcakkanlı bir ev sahibiydi. Sorularımıza anında dönüt verdi. Bizi rahat ettirmek için elinden geleni yaptı. Evin konumu da çok iyiydi. Tekrar teşekkür ediyoruz.

Mustafa is a nice and young host. the apartment is old but very large and in acceptable conditions(cracks and wear here and there). There are many windows therefore it is so much light during the day.
The kitchen is nice and practical. The only short coming in the kitchen is the lack of coffee maker, espresso machine or anything you can make a coffee with but you canuse the milk pot for that and it works very well! ;). There are not spices in the kitchen for cooking also (I have noticed some in other airbnb accomodation).
overall experience was nice and pleasant.
the balcony is a big plus if the weather is nice.
learn how to work with water heater, it needs some try and error ;). Ask mustafa!
Mustafa bey ilgili iletişimi kuvvetli bir ev sahibiydi. İlanda belirtilen tüm olanaklar doğru ve ev muhteşemdi. Her şey için teşekkürler
Ada’da çok güzel ve huzur dolu bir konumdaki evde geçirdiğimiz her dakika çok keyifliydi. Mustafa Beyin ev sahipliği de oldukça samimi ve cana yakındı. Her şey için çok teşekkürler.
Evin konumu harikaydı, tekrar kalmak için ideal.

description: Enjoy a comfortable stay in this quiet, centrally located place with its stylish, comfortable and balcony feature. Our house is in the most decent and safe district of Istanbul. It is on the 1st floor and does not have an elevator. When you come to our house, we are sure that you will feel much more than what you see in the pictures. You should definitely experience it. You can also enjoy unlimited 100 mbps internet and Netflix and similar applications loaded on the TV.

reviews.text:
We really enjoyed our stay here. Buket is a fantastic host, very responsive and kind. Check-in and check-out went really well.
The location is central and quiet, the metro station is within 10min walking distance, from there you can reach the most important areas of the city.
The apartment is very clean and spacious, just like on the photos. We would definitely recommend this place for your stay in Istanbul.

The place was clean and comfortable, and the host was very kind and helpful — communication was quick and easy. The location is excellent: it’s close to Taksim Square and Istiklal Street (a short walk uphill), and going down the stairs you’re quickly near the tram stop and Kabataş ferry pier, so it’s very well connected to all kinds of public transport. The Cihangir neighborhood itself is lovely, full of charming cafés and small shops. Highly recommended — I’d happily stay again!

She was very nice, and the place was clean. Check-in was very smooth, and communication with her was excellent.
The only issue was that one of the beds was more suitable for a child and wasn’t very comfortable for an adult. Also, if you’re traveling with seniors, keep in mind that there are quite a few stairs and hills, both going up and down.
Overall, it was a good location and a pleasant stay if you don’t mind the walking and stairs.

Daire güzel, temiz ve merkezi konumdadır. Sokak sessizdir. Konumu mükemmeldir. Taksim meydanı, İstiklal caddesi ve farklı ulaşım (metro, tramvay, otobüs vb) 3 dakika mesafededir. Daire 3 yatak odalı ve büyüktür. Keyifli bir balkonu vardır. Ev fotoğraflardaki gibidir. İhtiyacımız olan her şey vardı. İnternet hızıda çok iyiydi. Buket harika bir ev sahibiydi. Son derece yardımsever ve hızlı yanıt verdi. Burada kalarak harika vakit geçirdik. Herkese tavsiye ederim. Tekrar geleceğiz.

Lovely place and perfect location near to all the famous attractions. You can easily walk to Taksim from the apartment and explore the area and enjoy shopping in Ist.Street and if you are fan of nightlife: the party is there. Access to Metro when you also can catch the ride to the Airport or to connect to Asian Part. So the location is perfect for around: Galata Tower, Golden Horn and easy to go doing Bosphorus Trip. The apartment is as you can see in the photos shown. Very clean, it is quite warm you don't need to worry make yourself comfortable as your home.
Buket and her husband waited for us in front of the house and checked us in even it was 12:00 am and the process was veryyy smoothly. We liked a lot Buket's place and will definitely come back again. it was a hidden gem (quite neighborhood even though in the heart of Istanbul).
Thanx again Buket for making our stay easy and lovely!

description: Welcome to our best flat. It's located 2 min. from Taksim Square on a quiet street in Cihangir. It's a 3 min. walk from the metro station and everything you need is very nearby. You will feel very comfortable here. Our place is 70sqm with terrace.

reviews.text:
This apartment is a great booking! It super central, just off Taksim Square (which is well connected trough public transportation, to and from the airport, and all taxi drivers know where it is). The apartment is within short walking distance from Taksim Square, and easy to find!
With codes provided for the two first doors, and a system for picking up and dropping off keys in privacy, makes check in and out, super easy, flexible and quick.
We never met the host, but communication was polite, helpful and with a quick respondence.
The apartment looks just like in the photos. Welcoming, modern and practical. The kitchen is well equipped, you are provided plenty of towels and everything was clean and tidy.
I absolutely recommend to book this apartment if it's available on the dates of your travels. It's great value and with no compromise a good and comfortable place to stay.

Berna is a fine host. She is quick to respond and very helpful. Car service from airport was arranged and a minor problem at the flat was promptly repaired. The welcome chocolates and bottled water were a nice touch. The flat is as described, very nice and clean. Be aware the flat is four flights of winding stairs up and a steep hill climb away from Taksim. Old town and most sites require transport but metro and tram are nearby.

This was my first trip to Istanbul, and I was lucky to pick a flat that was both very safe and comfortable and offered great access to all parts of the city.
The flat is a very clean, cozy one bedroom at the top floor of a building about 2 minutes from Taksim square. Being in the top floor, I didn't need to deal with noises from above which always annoy me. It's pretty quiet considering it is at the center of the city. There's no lift, so you have to climb the stairs to the top; it's the 4th/5th floor. I didn't mind it since I come from a very sedentary lifestyle, so I needed that extra calories burnt :)
My fiance and I stayed at the flat for 15 days and we found in there everything we needed. There was literally nothing missing, and yes we cooked several times. The kitchen is fully equipped, and if anything was needed our host Berna offered to provide it though we never got to that point.
The flat is very clean; I loved the shower and its pressure, better than what I have at home. The bed was very comfortable, and we hung out a lot on the very comfy couch in the living room. You also have access to two terraces that offer nice view of the neighborhood.
The place is about 2 minutes walking distance to the Taksim square, a bit of an uphill though but I didn't mind it at all.
A great thing about the place is that you have access to EVERYTHING within less than a minute of walking: supermarkets, fruit shops, professional laundry services if you need, butcher shop, coffee shop, restaurants, etc. We didn't even need to walk to Taksim square to get stuff if we needed something in the unit. Just want down and fetched it from one of the stores by the apartment.
All public transportations are within a few minutes of walking distance from the flat. We could walk 3-5 minutes to get to the bus, metro station, tramway, the tour buses, etc. which allowed us to explore all parts of Istanbul, Asia and Europe. Staying at Berna's flat you won't need taxi.
Last but not least, Berna our host: she is a great host. She left us water and chocolates in the flat when we got there. She was available all the time for any questions or help, whether about the flat or the city. We communicated through text, and she'd respond within less than a minute.
Overall, during our 15 day stay there was absolutely no issues we encountered with the flat or the host. We both absolutely loved it and had a great time.
I highly recommend this place to any person, or couple who's visiting Istanbul, especially if it is your first time.
Thank you Berna!

We stayed in Berna's apartment for about a week and a half and I can say this is the best Airbnb I've ever stayed in.
The apartment is on the top floor which means no upstairs neighbors being noisy when you're trying to sleep. The bed is very comfortable and the bedroom faces the back of the building which is quiet. There is even a standing fan in the bedroom in case you get warm at night. The bedroom and living room each have a cute little balcony.
The bathroom is also very nice: plenty of hot water that does not run out while showering. I liked this shower even more than my home shower! The washer/dryer is of excellent quality and much faster than most other European washers I've used. There is also a drying rack if you don't want to use the dryer for your clothes. A hairdryer and plenty of shampoo are also provided.
We did not use the kitchen at all but it seemed to have everything you should need for cooking. Berna left water for us in the fridge to get us started which was very thoughtful (please do not drink the tap water in Turkey. Plenty of places nearby to purchase more drinking water for extremely cheap prices).
The living room couch is incredibly comfortable and there is satellite TV with many channels for when you want to relax.
Check-in and check-out were both very easy and stress free.
The location is optimal. You are close to Taksim square so you can grab the M2 subway and a ton of buses to get to all kinds of stuff. The apartment is also walkable to the T1 tram and even more buses in that area which goes to many tourist attractions in Sultanahmet, Fatih, and beyond. Karaköy and Galata areas are also walkable from here with heaps of good restaurants. The street the apartment is on has numerous grocery and fruit shops as well as a few restaurants (I highly recommend eating at Altın Şiş a few doors down), and beyond that there are TONS of restaurants in close walking proximity.
Overall this is a top notch apartment and an incredible value. Next time I come to Turkey if this apartment is available I will absolutely stay again.

In general the apartment was ok. It has a very central and nice location. You have a tram station where you can just jump in and reach all the touristic places. We do not recommend to drive too much with taxi, since Istanbul is horrible with the traffic, therefore the tram is way better.
Berna was available to write and to answer the phone if we needed. She sent us an information message with everything we needed to reach the apartment from the Airport.
About the apartment:
The apartment is on the last floor of the building and there is no elevator, which I think is normal in old building from the city.
The photos of the apartment are not very current. The apartment need s little bit of update with tiny things. For example the shower needs a fix, because the water comes from the sides of the pipe. The chairs outside from the bed - balcony are not the newest. The big balcony was missing the umbrella - Berna offered to replace it, but it wasn´t necessary since it is better to wait for the sun to come down. It is just too hot to sit outside during summer. During our arrival there was water in the fridge. We had coffee and tea available.
When we arrive the bed was done, but it looked like that nobody was there for quite a while and it was a bit dusty - so we had to dust off a little. At the head of the bed was also dusty. The bed was ok, but I think that it needs already a change.
We didn´t manage to start the TV and there was no handbook or guide how to do it. It looked like the plug was not working and there was no Aux cable to conect any other device. So, the TV didn´t work. We had WiFi, but no the fastest connection, but it worked so it was also ok.
We think that the place has a great location and potential, however it needs already a little update.

description:
Stylish apartment with a detached garden in the eye-catching center of Kadıköy, close to Yoğurtçu Park. A place where you can have a great time with the patio and seating groups in the garden. You can easily find various cafes, patisseries and restaurants around. Transportation is very close to everywhere, and a peaceful apartment awaits you.
A perfect home for families, groups of friends and business trips.

reviews.text: A basement apartment with a garden in a great location. Everything is walkable from here for Kadikoy area and lots of cafes, restaurants and shops not far from the apartment. Canan the host was also super kind, flexible and very responsive. Thank you Canan. The only issue we encountered is that one of the bedrooms directly faces the road (street level windows) this bedroom was very loud with cars, motorbikes and people coming through till late at night. If you don’t mind one of the bedrooms being noisy then it will be fine for you. Thanks!

We stayed at Canan's unit after having a bad experience at a prior airbnb booking, and having to find a new location within a day. Canan communicated very promptly with us, and showed us the unit, handed the keys, despite being injured from an earlier accident. She was a great host who provided great care and thoughtfulness throughout our experience.
Canan's unit is located in a great area of Kadikoy, it's very walkable to many restaurants and shops. There is public (paid) parking very closeby. The street that it's on is quiet. And the backyard of the unit provides a great escape from the city, and a great option for families with kids.
We had an excellent time and would love to stay at Canan's place in our next visit.

Çanan was the perfect host. From the beginning to the end of our trip, she made us feel very welcome in Istanbul and in her lovely (and clean) apartment nested in trendy Kadiköy.
We loved the location, close to busy and buzzy Moda, yet in a very calm spot with a lovely terrace. Plenty of cool bars, shops, and restaurants, but the area remains very local and is not too touristy. Our neighbours, the cats, were very quiet and discrete.
We also enjoyed Çanan’s little attentions, her advice on the city, and her availability. We would gladly come back and would recommend her apartment to any traveler.
Çok teşekkür ederim, Çanan! See you next time :)

We stayed at Canan's place with four adults and two small children for six days. We had a great time in Kadıköy. The borough is busy with great cafés, restaurants, playgrounds for children and basically everything you need. The place is close to the sea and the promenade, which is awesome if you want to go for a run or a walk. If you're into football, Fenerbahce stadium is also around the corner.
The train station, metro, and ferry are pretty close.
The apartment is big enough for 4 adults and a good base for a stay in Istanbul. The garden and patio are awesome for little breaks, and there is also a small slide for children.
However, you should know that one of the rooms goes straight to the street with the windows just below the sidewalk. So, if you want to keep those open at night, make sure to bring earplugs.
In summation, there was nothing to complain about. Canan was a great host and very helpful. She even offered to pick us up at the station upon our arrival. Thank you,Canan.
Beautiful home in a fantastic location. Host was very helpful and friendly, met us on arrival and was very informative. Would highly recommend for a stay in Istanbul!

description:
- Pesa Suites offers its guests a comfortable accommodation experience with its stylish and modern design.
- in the center of Istanbul
- There is a 24-hour reception service and daily cleaning.

reviews.text: Price for location is perfect, easy to find and really good location - room was very warm (great for winter travels). The room wasn’t exactly like the picture but it was still great, clean and had everything we needed - walls a little thin but there wasn’t any noisy neighbors so overall no issues whatsoever. We enjoyed our stay and we’d stay here again:)

We ended up enjoying very much staying at Pesa Suites. I was a bit nervous after the first night because we had some noisy neighbours, but they left the next morning so it was ok after that.
Erhan was very helpful and responsive, the guys at the reception were very nice too and glad to always help with recommendations, with our luggages etc. But what we liked the most was the location, it was very close to Galata port, walkable distance to Fatih, to Taksim square, to Galata Tower of course, which you could see from the window and the neighbourhood was really nice.
Also, from our room we couldn’t hear the outside noise because the window wasn’t oriented to the street.
Overall was a good experience!

Erhan’s place has a great location just 1 min from Tophane station, 3 min to Galataport and 5 min to Istiklal street, making it very convenient. The space was wonderfully comfortable and clean. The view of Galata Tower from the bed was magical both night and day. I would stay here again anytime.

the location of the place was very close to the tram and bus station (3min walk). the place was very clean, a little small but we barely spent time inside so it wasn’t an issue for us. The walls are thin so you will hear neighbors entering and exiting their room, but it wasn’t a disturbance for us at all. The staff were are very nice and friendly. For the price we paid, it was the best deal. So worth it! Will definitely come back if I visit again.

The location is perfect. The place offers all you need to feel comfy. The guy working on the reception is very helpful, our car broke and he helped us with everything he could. There is a coffe shop right infron, and a kebap place right next to the entrance .The room is clean, we had amazing time. Thank you

description:
Fully Furnished Luxury House in City Centre

25 meters to Osmanbey Metro Station- 15 mins by walk to Taksim Square- Cevahir Shopping Mall and Nişantaşı Main Street

This apartment also has 12 square meter balcony for private usage

reviews.text: The apartment's location is excellent, very central and accessible. We booked for three, but the sofa bed was broken. Fortunately, Karim quickly arranged another apartment, and we had a comfortable stay. The kitchen had basic equipment, which was enough for breakfast. Cleanliness was average; some towels and pillowcases were stained but replaced promptly. The host was very responsive and helpful throughout. The first night, the neighbor was a bit noisy due to a shared wall, but it was quiet afterward. The TV, air conditioning, and internet worked perfectly.

Osmanbey metro durağına sadece 1 dakika yürüme mesafesinde, cadde üzerinde oldukça merkezi bir konumda olmasına rağmen ev gayet sessizdi. Ev, fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi temiz ve düzenliydi. Herhangi bir sorumuz olduğunda Mehmet Bey’e kolayca ulaşabildik ve iletişimi çok rahattı. Sadece Wi-Fi bağlantısında zaman zaman yavaşlama ve kopmalar yaşadık. Bunun dışında konaklamamızdan memnun kaldık. İstanbul’da konaklama ihtiyacım olduğunda yeniden tercih edebilirim. Teşekkür ederim.

I had a wonderful stay at Karim's accommodation in Istanbul. Everything was exactly as described in the listing. Karim was incredibly helpful and responsive throughout my stay. The home itself was exceptionally clean, and the furniture provided a cozy and comfortable atmosphere. The location was perfect, with supermarkets, restaurants, both local and branded shops, and pharmacies all within walking distance. The convenience of having all essential amenities nearby was truly impressive, and the availability of various transportation options meant that a car wasn't necessary. Mehmet, who assisted with check-in and check-out, might not speak English, but he was incredibly helpful. I used a translation app to communicate with him, and he made sure I had everything I needed. Overall, my experience was fantastic, and I highly recommend Karim's accommodation to others.

This was our second stay with Kerim(Different flat, same host). Flat was very very clean, bed linens were without a single spot. Surfaces didn't have any dust. Shower was also really clean. Apartment is two minutes from Osmanbey Metro station and Osmanbey is 1 stop away from Taksim. We never used but there is also a small balcony. We didn't feel unsafe in the night, you don't need to worry. There are nice restaurants and bakeries around. Osmanbey is not the main attraction for tourists but there are "hidden gems" such as old buildings and churches. Our host was again really nice and responsive. We came earlier than expected but the flat was ready and he let us in.
The location is excellent, the apartment is exactly like in the photos,cozy and comfortable.The host Kerim is very responsive. Definitely worth the price

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text: Easy check in, clean room and bed sheets. Unscratched pans and an actually usefull kitchen... As advertised, as a solid choice for the price!
Great location and clean. Easy check in. Worth the price.

the place is cool. it was neat clean . kitchenette was properly stocked with cookware,etc. bed was well made. all fell in olace
place.
the only drawback is bathroom lacked proper ventilation.
no elevator.
otherwise place was fine

Gayet güzel bir konaklama deneyimi oldu. Apart fotoğraflarda açıkçası daha büyük gözüküyordu ancak olması gerektiği gibiydi. Temizlik konusunda bir kusur göremedim. Klima çalışmıyordu anladığım kadarıyla, ancak net bir şey söylemem doğru olmaz çünkü çalışıp çalışmadığını sormadık. Girişte ve çıkışta bizi güleryüzlü insanlar karşıladı. Anladığım kadarıyla genel bir tadilat mevcut, biraz tadilat kokusu vardı binada ve odamızda. Banyo gayet temizdi. Mutfak için bulaşık sabunu vs. de olsaydı daha güzel olabilirdi. Konum için konuşmak gerekirse açıkçası oldukça rahat bir yerde. Şişli Cami'ye 5 dk yürüme yolu var. Biz memnun kaldık. Her şey için teşekkür ederiz.
Great location for my needs. Metin and his team are very responsive. The apartment itself needs a little work but it was still worth the stay! I would stay again.

description: Our suits are furnished and have comfortable real bed, full equipped kitchen and equipped bathroom. There is free wireless internet connection and cable tv.

reviews.text: We spent six nights in Safa apartment. It is extremely well located near metro and easy to get to all the main attractions. It was clean and spacious with a nice kitchen to cook meals. Bed is large and comfortable. We really enjoyed our stay in the apartment and the beautiful city.

Wasim is the staff in the building, he is very helpful and offer a simple orientation during check-in procedure.
I have stayed for 2 nights, and location is in Taksim, very convenient to walk to Taksim square. The area is safe and easy to get around as Metro is within 5 mins walk. Highly recommend if you would like a good location and living space bigger than a hotel and with clothes washing facility. Just one note: Hot water in the bathroom is not consistent. When mention, Safa said he would fix it. Walls are a bit thin, could hear the neighbours talking, but not an big issue for me. Overall, it's a nice place to stay at.

We enjoyed the apartment very much. It was very clean, modern, and stylish. Comfortable bed and sofa. The location was excellent and we had everything we needed. Safa was very friendly and made sure we felt welcomed.

I would not recommend you to choose the Saga's place (Sheriff residence). There are few issues which I had personally:
1. The cockroaches in the room
2. Noise from the street, hall and other rooms (difficult to sleep)
3. Safa has provided not the same room which I was booking (way smaller and not that good condition)
4. The host did not respect our agreement to meet and twice I was waiting my time waiting for him in the hotel to solve issues
5. I was doing some plumber job as the pipes in the shower were aged and in bad condition
The only good thing is there were a possibility to have early check in and for that I have put 1 Star!

This is the place where i highly recommended to stay in short or long term of time..all you need is here (the location, comfort, safe, clean) and the most is the hospitality of the owner / management and they are very helpful .. cok guzel 👍.. tesekurler edirim 👌

description:
You will feel the comfort in every detail in our 1+0 apartment, which includes a comfortable workspace, mini kitchen, smart TV and high-speed internet.
Whether for business or pleasure...
Feel at home on all your short or long trips.
Thanks to the self check-in system, you can check in at any time and start your stay effortlessly without waiting. All check-in information is sent to you after booking. Cleanliness, safety and comfort are our priorities.

reviews.text:
check in was very easy, the place was very clean, little bit small but it was enough,and the staff downstairs was very helpful.
I would recommend to stay there
temiz, düzenli, bakımlı. konumu çok iyi, karşısında taksi durağı var minibüs güzergahlarına vs yakın. gönül rahatlığıyla bir daha tercih edeceğim bir yer.
Bir çok özelliği gerçekten çok iyiydi, konumu merkeziydi ve bulması kolaydı. Banyo, havlular, mutfak tezgahı, mobilyalar ve yatak oldukça temizdi. Kaliteli bir hizmet sunuldu teşekkür ederim.
Sizin için herşey düşünülmüş. Çok temizdii. Çalışanlar çok ilgililer. Her yere ulaşım olarak çok rahat. Rahatlıkla kalabilirsiniz.

Güzergah olarak İstanbul’un her tarafına gidebileceğiniz ulaşıma yakın bir konumda yer alıyor. Ev balkonunda keyifli sohbetler yapabilirsiniz . Evin içerisi beklediğimden daha hijyenikti. Rahat bir konaklama sağladık. Sorularımıza hızlı yanıt verildi. Sanırım bir daha geleceğim.

description:
-This unit is located in one of the most central places in Istanbul. The building stands right besides the historical Camondo Stairs. You can walk to;
-Galata Tower,
-Karaköy,
-Galataport
-and Taksim in 5-10 mins.

You can also take the metro, tram, busses to anywhere.

-The 2 most important things we care is your security and hygiene. The building belongs to us. All rooms are cleaned by professionals cleaners.

reviews.text:
The location was amazing. It was right above the Camondo stairs with a secure entrance, and a few steps away from Galata Tower and Istiklal. Few steps away from the ferry and transportation.
The bed was very comfortable. A/C worked well. Internet was fast. Room was modern, quiet and insulated, and had everything we needed. It had a premium feel to it.
I could have stayed much longer!
Eylül, the host, was great and took us out to coffee, gave tons of recommendations, and offered to give us tour of the city. One time we forgot the keys in the room and she was there in seconds. Best host ever!
Bankalar street is a very unique part of Istanbul with its own history. Outside, everyone is taking photoshoots, bridal photos, selfies. Lots of cats and kittens running around!
I would recommend this place and would come back.

I was greeted by Rumeysa. She is so friendly and helpful. My transfer could not get to the street due to traffic so she came down and helped me with my bags and got me settled in. She was always available if I needed anything at all.
Now for the Airbnb. This place was perfect! Location location location! I was worried that it might be loud because of where it is situated, but it’s very well insulated and you barely hear anything from the street at all, even though its a very busy area. I didn’t use the kitchen while there but it seemed to be well equipped. The bed was comfortable and the linens were crisp and clean. The bathroom was nice and there was a washing machine. Though I didn’t need it as I had my own, they provided body wash, shampoo and conditioner. The Wi-Fi is strong, probably the best I had my entire stay in Türkiye. The building is secure with a fob to get in and out.
It was a great stay. I will stay at DeCamondo again when visiting Istanbul should it be available.

The apartment is comfortable and clean and I loved the location. It's just a few minutes to all the action in Karakoy, Galataport and Galata Tower. The bathroom and kitchens are modern, it has high ceilings and has lots of natural light.
Rumeysa is so friendly and helpful, she was wonderful. I would stay here again.
Good location. Fun to see all the wedding photo shoots at the adjacent “Camondo Stairs” each day. Quiet, clean space and very walkable to major attractions/locations. We would stay there again.

I stayed in the place with my family and we had a great time together! Apartments absolutely pleased all our needs - fully equiped kitchen, separated shower and tolet, very clean and whenever we needed more towels or anything at the apartment - that was timely proposed. Super friendly host and actually Rumeysa is making a difference with her friendlyness and wonderful smile. absolutely perfect for 2 people, but we managed to stay 3 of us there and that was comfortable. Location is amazing. In general all properties of DeCamondo is One Love! Thanks a lot for making Istanbul so friendly and stylish! :)

description: We will be happy to welcome you in our suite with a balcony located on the 1st floor of our facility, which has a 24/7 reception. It is located 3 minutes from Galatasaray high school on Istiklal street. 2 minutes walk to the bus station and 15 minutes to the metro stops. Our rooms have Wi-Fi, air conditioning and central heating. The access to the rooms is via stairs.

reviews.text:
Place are looked like the photos, clean and neat. Also it is bear to the bus station (2mins walking) and a minute to the main street.
The host is very nice, helpful and will answer you anytime.
Very recommended place.

The stay was amazing. Host is responsive and takes extra measures to accommodate the guests. The apartment is clean. There is a bus station in 2 minutes walking distance which can take you basically anywhere. If you walk a little to the south, crossing the road with the bus station, you will get to the beautiful long street full of shops and restaraunts. We slept well and unlike in many other apartments in istanbul there was no noise from cars and neighbors, the place was very quiet and cozy. Highly recommend.

Pros:
- Central location with lots of restaurants nearby, 5 mins walk from Istiklal, 20 mins from coast
- Comfy bed
- Speedy WiFi
- Laundry can be done on request
Cons:
- Can be loud at night, near a major street
- Only a small hob available for cooking
Worked remotely for one month, Zübeyde was very responsive and helpful to my requests, thanks so much again 🙏
The apartment is great just the same as the photos and calm neighborhood, the host is amazing, sure will consider it on my next visit. Great hospitality..

Nice stay , great location , almost at the bus station , near Istiklal street , famous restaurants, easy to find , safe neighborhood , kind uncle at the reception, the host is very responsive , price: quality is perfect, enjoyed it!

description: The entire group will have easy access to all sites and amenities from this central accommodation. Located 200 meters from the Bosphorus Bridge with a wonderful view of Ortaköy.

reviews.text:
The place is overall big and spacious. And it has all basic amenities. However, it requires better cleaning (saw some hair and dust on the floor and under the furniture) and broader renovation: there were some broken furniture, bathtub and shower, etc.
Wifi, TV work properly 👌🏻
Parking is an issue in the area, so if you plan to use your car every day — look for paid parking nearby.
Windows from two of the bedrooms face destroyed/burned building :)
Overall, the place is in great location for our purpose — bosporus swim 2025.
The host was very responsive and tried to solve all the issues that we had.

The apartment was big, with 3 spacious bedrooms. Close to a very populated area with loads of restaurants. Also there were many shops nearby and a walkable distance to bus stations. The negatives now: the apartment was not very clean, especially the bathroom needs some refurbishment. But the biggest problem was the parking space. If you come by car speak with the host beforehand and even so it’s difficult to find a parking space in that area.

Olcay was an great host, clear instructions on what to do on arrival, we had a problem with internet straight but he was ready to solve it quickly. Spacious and clean house with clean sheets and towels in every room, every little detail is thought of. I loves the location easy walk to sea and restaurants.

Ev konum olarak oldukça iyi bir yerde ulaşımı rahat, evin temizliği ve güvenliği çok iyiydi. Ev sahibi ilgili ve anlayışlıydı. Kalacak misafirlere tavsiye ederim. Özellikle aileler gönül rahatlığıyla kalabilir.

I had a wonderful experience with Olcay's department. The cleanliness was impeccable, which made me feel comfortable and at ease. Olcay was incredibly helpful. I highly recommend his department and appreciate the excellent service I received.

description:
This 85 sqm 2 bedroom apartment is tastefully decorated with white and wooden colour tones, use of modern and comfortable furnitures, and the stone work details.
I hope this will offer you and your family a perfect alternative for your short or long stays, for business or leisure trips.
The flat comes with all the modern amenities like Wi-Fi, satellite TV, smart TV, comfortable bedding and much more.
There is elevator.

reviews.text:
I'll begin with the positives:
- The place is in a great location. It's minutes away from the Galata tower and 5 minutes from the Karaköy tram stop.
- The host is responsive and professional.
- The check-in was smooth.
- The flat has almost everything you need for your stay.
Here are things that could be improved:
- There are two beds and one sofa bed. The smaller bed isn't good and comfortable for light sleepers. If you are two, when one moves, the other will wake up due to spring noise and noticeable movement.
- The living room, where the sofa bed is, can get very noisy at night when cars and motors pass. There are crevices around the window, letting air and noise in.
- The lighting is dim at night, giving it a gloomy feeling.
- There were mold spots in the bathroom. Also, the bathroom ventilator didn't work.
- There was a warning on the lift door prohibiting its use due to safety issues.
- In summary, we had higher expectations given the price.

My stay was fantastic. The place was very clean, and had an excellent location with easy access to everything. The management was also very responsive to all our needs.
The setup includes two separate rooms, with a shared bathroom. The beds were cozy for a few days' stay, and we found a coffee machine with supplies, a fridge, and 1 big bottle of water as a welcome gift. Washing machine. The bathroom was well-equipped with soap, shampoo, and very clean towels. The kitchen was fully equipped.
There’s a tiny balcony with a beautiful view of galata tower, perfect for enjoying a quick morning coffee. The peaceful atmosphere makes it a great alternative to cafes, offering a quiet start to the day.
There was air conditioning, though we didn’t need to use it bcz it was winter.
Finally, security was important to me as I often returned late at night. The street felt safe, and I could walk around comfortably since there were police patrols passing by from time to time.

The accommodation was excellent, bigger than we expected. Everything was clean, the linens, the beds were comfortable! The kitchen was well equipped although we didn't cook, but there is a dishwasher! Everything within walking distance. The apartment is on a very nice street, in a nice tidy building!
It was the best choice!
Everything went smoothly with the host!

We had a wonderful stay at Metin’s apartment. The location is amazing, just a short walk from Galataport and close to many restaurants, shops, and attractions. The apartment is spacious, very clean, comfortable, and well equipped. The hosts were excellent, very friendly, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay. We really enjoyed our time here and would definitely stay again. Highly recommended!

The apartment is very well located and very comfortable. We stayed comfortably for 6 people, including my friends. The apartment had everything we needed. The owner, Mr. Faruk, took very good care of us and helped us with our other needs. It was very easy to reach him. We could communicate with him at any time. The entrance and access to the apartment is very easy and there is also an elevator, which was very important for us. The apartment was very warm, both air conditioning and natural gas were available, we did not experience any problems. It is very easy to reach public transportation and metro from home, and it is also very close to the Galata Tower, so we could easily reach anywhere we wanted. We will definitely stay again on our next visit to Istanbul.
